items.title_en: Three-dimensional mapping of human lung fibrosis identifies spatial coupling between tissue microarchitecture and maladaptive repair states
items.title_zh: 人类肺纤维化的三维图谱揭示组织微结构与适应不良修复状态之间的空间耦合
items.abstract_en: Human lung fibrosis progressively destroys three-dimensional tissue architecture, yet how the structural microenvironment shapes cellular states remains unclear. Integrating 3D X-ray histology with spatial omics, we generate a volumetric multimodal atlas of human lung fibrosis that enables direct interrogation of relationships between tissue microarchitecture and spatial molecular programmes. We identify collapse of the alveolar-capillary unit - the coupled loss of alveolar type 1 epithelial cells, capillary endothelial cells, and basement membrane integrity - as a structural transition associated with early fibrogenesis. Surrounding transitional zones exhibit aberrant epithelial differentiation and proteolytic matrix remodelling, with epithelium shifting toward bronchiolised, airway-like states. Stromal activation converges on spatially restricted fibrogenic cores, sites of maximal collagen maturation and matrix stabilisation that function as signalling hubs within surrounding perifocal and vascular microenvironments. Molecular signatures of atlas-defined tissue states were associated with lung function and mortality across independent patient cohorts. Together, these data support a model in which fibrosis emerges as a spatial tissue-state process, with alveolar-capillary collapse redirecting repair towards mechanically stabilised niches that reinforce pathological remodelling.
items.abstract_zh: 人类肺纤维化会逐步破坏三维组织结构，但结构微环境如何塑造细胞状态仍不清楚。我们将三维 X 射线组织学与空间组学整合，生成了人类肺纤维化的体积多模态图谱，可直接探究组织微结构与空间分子程序之间的关系。我们识别出肺泡-毛细血管单元塌陷——即肺泡 1 型上皮细胞、毛细血管内皮细胞和基底膜完整性的耦合丧失——是与早期纤维化发生相关的结构转变。周围的过渡区表现出异常的上皮分化和蛋白水解性基质重塑，上皮向细支气管化、气道样状态转变。基质活化汇聚于空间受限的促纤维化核心，这些核心是胶原成熟和基质稳定程度最高的部位，在周围的病灶周边和血管微环境中充当信号枢纽。图谱定义的组织状态的分子特征在独立患者队列中与肺功能和死亡率相关。总之，这些数据支持一个模型：纤维化作为一个空间组织状态过程出现，肺泡-毛细血管塌陷将修复重定向至机械稳定的生态位，从而强化病理性重塑。

items.title_en: An Agent-Driven, Cross-Validated Inverse-Design Pipeline for Dielectric Metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 一种智能体驱动、交叉验证的介质超表面逆向设计流程
items.abstract_en: Inverse design of dielectric metasurfaces is powerful but labour-intensive: each new target requires choosing a parameterization and a figure of merit, managing compute resources, and critically assessing results that may be numerically unconverged, sensitive to fabrication errors or trapped in local optima. Here we present an open-source pipeline in which an artificial intelligence (AI) coding agent turns a plain-language specification into metasurface optimization runs, executes them, analyses every run with a fixed checklist and proposes the next iteration. Designs are optimized with differentiable three-dimensional rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA), including robustness to fabrication tolerances, and every reported design is independently verified with finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations. We demonstrate the workflow at 1550 nm on a freeform silicon metagrating, on a polarization-independent meta-atom library assembled into beam-deflecting supercells, and on metalenses built from the same library. In the metagrating case, the independent FDTD verification revealed a 5\% overestimate of the efficiency by the optimization model that a conventional convergence test had not detected, and the robust design retained most of its efficiency under $\pm$10~nm fabrication errors. In the other cases, instead, the obtained RCWA results are confirmed by full-wave simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 介质超表面的逆向设计功能强大但 labour-intensive：每个新目标都需要选择参数化和品质因数、管理计算资源，并批判性评估可能数值未收敛、对制造误差敏感或陷入局部最优的结果。我们提出一个开源流程，其中人工智能（AI）编码智能体将自然语言规格说明转化为超表面优化运行，执行这些运行，用固定检查清单分析每次运行并提议下一次迭代。设计通过可微的三维严格耦合波分析（RCWA）优化，包括对制造容差的鲁棒性，并且每个报告的设计都用有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真独立验证。我们在 1550 nm 下展示了该工作流：一个自由形状硅超光栅、一个组装成光束偏转超胞的偏振无关超原子库，以及由同一库构建的超透镜。在超光栅案例中，独立的 FDTD 验证揭示了优化模型将效率高估 5%，而传统收敛测试未能检测到这一点；鲁棒设计在 ±10 nm 制造误差下保留了大部分效率。而在其他案例中，所获得的 RCWA 结果得到了全波仿真的确认。

items.title_en: Compositional Unalignment: Auditing Safety in Large Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 组合性去对齐：审计大型视觉-语言模型的安全性
items.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are vulnerable to compositional harm: an image and a prompt that are benign in isolation become harmful through the model's cross-modal reasoning. Recent alignment methods report strong scores on compositional safety benchmarks, but an LLM judge only measures observed behavior and cannot reveal how robustly safety is integrated into the model. We argue that un-alignment provides a complementary audit of alignment robustness. We first show that minimal supervised fine-tuning reaches an LLM-judge score comparable to a multi-stage reinforcement-learning pipeline, so similar benchmark scores cannot establish robustness by themselves. We then show that recognition and refusal of compositional harm are decoupled: nine standard direction-finding methods detect compositional harm with up to AUC=0.99, yet ablating the recovered directions either leaves refusal intact or destroys model coherence. We therefore propose CMaG, a training-free un-alignment method for compositional safety. CMaG measures refusal intention with a refusal-versus-compliance log-probability margin, takes its gradient with respect to mid-layer activations, and contrasts it against partially benign pairs to isolate the cross-modal interaction term. A single backward pass over 80 examples yields a direction along which steering monotonically converts refusal into compliance. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, CMaG reduces compositional safety scores by up to 65 points while over 98% of outputs remain coherent, outperforming gradient-based baselines; the direction also transfers to text-explicit harm and un-aligns models hardened by defensive training. Compositional safety can thus appear behaviorally strong while remaining fragile to targeted internal intervention. Warning: this paper contains unsafe model outputs, including references to self-harm.
items.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）易受组合性危害：单独看无害的图像和提示，通过模型的跨模态推理会变得有害。近期的对齐方法在组合安全性基准上报告了很高的分数，但 LLM 评判器只衡量观察到的行为，无法揭示安全性被整合进模型的稳健程度。我们认为，去对齐提供了对对齐鲁棒性的补充审计。我们首先表明，最小化的监督微调可达到与多阶段强化学习流程相当的 LLM 评判分数，因此相似的基准分数本身不能确立鲁棒性。我们随后表明，组合性危害的识别与拒绝是解耦的：九种标准方向寻找方法检测组合性危害的 AUC 最高达 0.99，但消融所恢复的方向要么使拒绝保持不变，要么破坏模型连贯性。因此，我们提出 CMaG，一种用于组合安全性的免训练去对齐方法。CMaG 用拒绝与服从的对数概率边际度量拒绝意图，对其关于中间层激活求梯度，并将其与部分良性的配对进行对比，以分离跨模态交互项。对 80 个样本进行一次反向传播即可得到一个方向，沿该方向引导会单调地将拒绝转化为服从。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，CMaG 将组合安全性分数最多降低 65 分，同时超过 98% 的输出仍保持连贯，优于基于梯度的基线；该方向还可迁移到文本显式危害，并使经过防御性训练加固的模型去对齐。因此，组合安全性可以在行为上显得很强，却仍对有针对性的内部干预很脆弱。警告：本文包含不安全的模型输出，包括提及自残的内容。

items.title_en: The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model
items.title_zh: 模拟视角的几何：在多模态语言模型中分离表征与行为
items.abstract_en: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型可以模拟不同的观察者，但被赋予的视角如何重塑其内部表征以及这些变化是否支配其判断仍不清楚。我们研究了 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 中以人物设定为条件的视觉有趣度的表征几何。在 100 张图像和 53 种提示条件下，我们系统地改变人物设定内容以及引入该设定的语言框架，同时记录行为评分和逐层隐藏状态。我们观察到表征几何随处理深度发生系统性重组：早期层主要编码图像身份，而人物设定特定的结构出现在较晚层。引人注目的是，提示框架对内部表征的重塑强于人物设定身份，而人物设定内容对行为判断的影响更大。这种分离进一步由最小身份陈述体现：即使不改变回答，它们也会改变表征。这些发现表明，表征距离不一定反映行为相关性。更广泛地说，它们揭示了模拟视角如何在人工认知系统的表征空间中作为独特结构出现，强调了内部表征几何与其功能后果之间的根本区别。

items.title_en: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
items.title_zh: MOMASPLAT：面向移动操作任务的动态新视角示范增强
items.abstract_en: Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. Our key insight is that standard MoMa data collection naturally provides the multiview observations needed to reconstruct both the static scene and the manipulated object in 3D. MOMASPLAT combines 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward 3D foundation models, and kinematics-based action retargeting to separately reconstruct the scene and manipulated object, render them from novel viewpoints, and generate geometrically consistent synthetic demonstrations paired with transformed actions. We evaluate MOMASPLAT on five real-world mobile manipulation tasks involving both rigid and articulated objects across three scenes, and validate the fidelity of its synthesized demonstrations against ground truth in simulation. MOMASPLAT substantially improves robustness to unseen base poses, more than doubling the average success rate of the strongest baseline and maintaining non-trivial success at large base displacements where all baselines fail, while reducing the need for largescale real-world data collection.
items.abstract_zh: 通过模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略对相机视角变化高度敏感。这对移动操作（MoMa）尤其成问题，因为由于导航不确定性、定位漂移和环境约束，机器人很少从示范采集时使用的完全相同基座位姿执行操作。近期方法使用新视角合成（NVS）用未见视角增强示范，但它们假设静态场景，因此无法在接触后交互阶段重新渲染被操作物体，使示范中最关键的部分未被增强。我们提出 MOMASPLAT，一个面向移动操作的新视角示范增强框架，可从未见机器人基座位姿合成完整操作轨迹，包括动态物体交互。我们的关键洞察是，标准 MoMa 数据采集自然提供了在三维中重建静态场景和被操作物体所需的多视角观测。MOMASPLAT 结合三维高斯泼溅、前馈三维基础模型和基于运动学的动作重定向，分别重建场景与被操作物体，从新视角渲染它们，并生成与变换后动作配对的几何一致的合成示范。我们在三个场景中涉及刚性和铰接物体的五个真实世界移动操作任务上评估 MOMASPLAT，并在仿真中对照真值验证其合成示范的保真度。MOMASPLAT 显著提升了对未见基座位姿的鲁棒性，将最强基线的平均成功率提高一倍以上，并在所有基线都失败的大基座位移下保持非平凡的成功率，同时减少了对大规模真实世界数据采集的需求。

items.title_en: Structure from Collision via Hypothesis-Space Reasoning
items.title_zh: 基于假设空间推理的碰撞结构重建
items.abstract_en: Knowledge of the hidden interior structure of an object, including the presence and location of cavities, is essential for predictive simulation, robotic manipulation, and nondestructive inspection. However, such cavities leave no direct signature on the static visible surface, making collision-induced deformation one of the few cues used to infer their presence. Structure from Collision (SfC) addresses this problem by recovering the hidden interior structure of an object from multiview observations of a collision event. SfC is challenging for two reasons: hidden cavities are only indirectly observable through surface motion, and voids correspond to the absence of material, making direct optimization using standard density representations difficult. The density-based SfC baseline inherits both difficulties. Surface-matching gradients do not directly indicate the cavity location, while density gradients can be weak or uninformative inside or near void regions. Therefore, we reformulate SfC as hypothesis-space reasoning, representing hidden cavities as explicit structural hypotheses whose variables encode available structural assumptions rather than relying on implicit density updates. A global stage performs gradient-free optimization over this hypothesis space using forward-only material point method (MPM) simulation. A local stage then refines the selected hypothesis as a Lagrangian particle system through gradient-based optimization using differentiable MPM simulation. On the SfC benchmark, our method improves hidden-structure reconstruction and future prediction over the density-based SfC baseline. Interior-topology stress tests and robustness analyses characterize its scope and limitations. The project page is available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/.
items.abstract_zh: 物体隐藏内部结构（包括空腔的存在和位置）的知识对于预测性仿真、机器人操作和无损检测至关重要。然而，此类空腔在静态可见表面上没有直接特征，使得碰撞诱导的形变成为推断其存在的少数线索之一。Structure from Collision（SfC）通过从一次碰撞事件的多视角观测中恢复物体的隐藏内部结构来解决该问题。SfC 具有挑战性有两个原因：隐藏空腔只能通过表面运动间接观测；空洞对应于材料缺失，使得使用标准密度表示的直接优化变得困难。基于密度的 SfC 基线同时继承了这两个困难。表面匹配梯度不能直接指示空腔位置，而密度梯度在空洞区域内部或附近可能较弱或缺乏信息。因此，我们将 SfC 重新表述为假设空间推理，将隐藏空腔表示为显式结构假设，其变量编码可用的结构假设，而不是依赖隐式密度更新。全局阶段使用仅前向的物质点法（MPM）仿真在该假设空间上进行无梯度优化。随后，局部阶段将选定的假设作为拉格朗日粒子系统，通过使用可微 MPM 仿真的基于梯度的优化进行细化。在 SfC 基准上，我们的方法在隐藏结构重建和未来预测方面优于基于密度的 SfC 基线。内部拓扑压力测试和鲁棒性分析刻画了其范围和局限性。项目页面见 https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/。

items.title_en: A multi-scale cell-type resolved map of trans-regulatory architecture in the aging human brain
items.title_zh: 衰老人脑反式调控架构的多尺度细胞类型分辨图谱
items.abstract_en: Mapping genetic effects on distal genes and regulatory programs is essential for understanding how genetic variation influences complex diseases; yet trans-QTL discovery remains limited by weak effect sizes, extensive multiple testing and poor reproducibility. Here, we introduce TransMap, a generalizable computational framework that combines multi-scale trans-QTL mapping with multi-phenotype genetic colocalization to improve the discovery and interpretation of distal regulatory variants. Beyond individual trans-eGenes, TransMap constructs local co-regulatory program phenotypes that account for background expression variation to improve the detection of weak, coordinated distal genetic effects. Across a broad range of simulation settings, TransMap achieved 9.2-36.7% higher trans-QTL discovery power than existing methods while maintaining well-controlled type I error rates. We applied TransMap to bulk and single-nucleus transcriptomic profiles from the aging human brain in the ADSP Functional Genomics Consortium (FunGen-AD), further integrating proteomic, glycoproteomic and metabolomic biomarker measurements (average N=476 donors). Genome-wide fine-mapping of TransMap single-gene and program-level QTL yielded variant annotations with 2.75-2.88x heritability enrichment across 57 complex diseases and traits (average N=307K), with complementary heritability information captured across regulatory scales. Multi-phenotype colocalization identified 49,532 trans-regulatory events supported by shared genetic signals with cis-eQTL or biomarker-QTL, including 1,825 candidate cis-trans-biomarker regulatory configurations. TransMap further revealed an asymmetric cross-cell-type regulatory architecture in which neuronal cis-regulatory signals preferentially associate with coordinated glial trans-regulatory responses, supported by co-culture experiments and spatial transcriptomics. Alzheimer's disease (AD) GWAS-prioritized colocalization identified trans-regulatory associations in 115 AD-associated loci, including a KNOP1 cis-eQTL associated in trans with a microglial regulatory program containing MS4A4E, with additional support from statistical mediation analysis. TransMap provides a multi-scale, cell-type-resolved atlas of trans-regulatory variation and a generalizable framework for elucidating the regulatory architecture of complex diseases.
items.abstract_zh: 绘制遗传变异对远端基因和调控程序的影响，对于理解遗传变异如何影响复杂疾病至关重要；然而，trans-QTL 发现仍受限于效应量较弱、大量多重检验和可重复性差。在此，我们提出 TransMap，一个可推广的计算框架，将多尺度 trans-QTL 定位与多表型遗传共定位相结合，以改进远端调控变异的发现和解释。除单个 trans-eGene 外，TransMap 构建局部共调控程序表型，其考虑背景表达变异，以提高对微弱、协同的远端遗传效应的检测。在广泛的仿真设置中，TransMap 的 trans-QTL 发现功效比现有方法高 9.2–36.7%，同时保持良好控制的第一类错误率。我们将 TransMap 应用于 ADSP 功能基因组学联盟（FunGen-AD）中衰老人类大脑的批量及单核转录组图谱，进一步整合蛋白质组、糖蛋白质组和代谢组生物标志物测量（平均 N=476 名供体）。对 TransMap 单基因和程序水平 QTL 进行全基因组精细定位，得到的变异注释在 57 种复杂疾病和性状（平均 N=307K）中具有 2.75–2.88 倍的遗传力富集，并在不同调控尺度上捕获互补的遗传力信息。多表型共定位识别出 49,532 个反式调控事件，这些事件由与 cis-eQTL 或生物标志物-QTL 共享的遗传信号支持，包括 1,825 个候选 cis-trans-生物标志物调控配置。TransMap 进一步揭示了跨细胞类型的不对称调控架构，其中神经元 cis 调控信号优先与协同的胶质 trans 调控响应相关，并得到共培养实验和空间转录组学的支持。阿尔茨海默病（AD）GWAS 优先化的共定位在 115 个 AD 相关位点中识别出反式调控关联，包括一个 KNOP1 cis-eQTL 与包含 MS4A4E 的小胶质细胞调控程序发生反式关联，并得到统计中介分析的额外支持。TransMap 提供了 trans 调控变异的多尺度、细胞类型分辨图谱，以及一个用于阐明复杂疾病调控架构的可推广框架。

items.title_en: Approaching quantum limits in sub-Rayleigh resolution using phase modulation optimization
items.title_zh: 利用相位调制优化逼近亚瑞利分辨率中的量子极限
items.abstract_en: Spatial-mode demultiplexing (SPADE) has made significant progress in incoherent optical imaging and has been implemented through various experimental approaches. Holography-based SPADE is widely used in proof-of-principle experiments because of its low cost, stable optical arrangement, and ease of implementation. However, its low photon utilization severely limits its practical applications. Alternating Fourier transforms and phase modulations can implement unitary optical transformations. Building on this idea, we use backpropagation to optimize the phase profiles of spatial light modulators (SLMs) and thereby design quantum measurements that are efficient in both information and energy. We study centroid--separation estimation for two incoherent point sources, using Fisher information or the estimation errors of an auxiliary neural network estimator as optimization objectives. As the number of SLMs increases, the optimized measurements approach the quantum limits characterized by the quantum Cramér-Rao bound and the information-regret tradeoff relation. With a few SLMs, our method can outperform direct imaging, showing its potential for superresolution imaging.
items.abstract_zh: 空间模式解复用（SPADE）在非相干光学成像中取得了显著进展，并已通过多种实验方法实现。基于全息术的 SPADE 因其低成本、稳定光学布置和易于实现而广泛用于原理验证实验。然而，其低光子利用率严重限制了实际应用。交替傅里叶变换和相位调制可以实现酉光学变换。基于这一思想，我们使用反向传播优化空间光调制器（SLM）的相位分布，从而设计在信息和能量两方面都高效的量子测量。我们研究两个非相干点源的中心-间距估计，使用 Fisher 信息或辅助神经网络估计器的估计误差作为优化目标。随着 SLM 数量增加，优化后的测量逼近由量子 Cramér-Rao 界和信息-遗憾权衡关系刻画的量子极限。仅使用少量 SLM 时，我们的方法即可优于直接成像，显示出其在超分辨成像中的潜力。

items.title_en: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
items.title_zh: Muir：具有灵敏度分配门控与匹配滤波读出的线性注意力
items.abstract_en: Linear attention compresses context into a fixed-size key-value state for linear-time training and constant-memory inference. Gated delta-rule models decay this state and erase its prediction for an incoming key before writing a new value; Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) generalizes this with channel-wise decay and decoupled, full-rank erase and write gates. However, we show that state updates are far less sensitive to erasure than to writes: key activation and unit normalization concentrate key energy onto a sparse subset of channels, whereas value writes scale all channels, so the erase gate can be parameterized at lower rank. Furthermore, slow-decaying state rows accumulate much larger norms than fast rows, dominating unweighted readout and forcing stronger write-time erasure to suppress interference. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Muir, which fuses all gates into a sensitivity-allocated low-rank projection, re-weights state rows with a matched-filter readout gate, and reinvests the saved parameters in a wider feed-forward network. Because standard chunkwise algorithms become numerically unstable at the large chunk sizes needed to saturate wide matrix units, we design a parallel update for stable, efficient training. Across 166M-1.34B parameters, Muir lowers perplexity by 1.8-2.0% over GDN-2 and 2.5-3.6% over Transformer, raises commonsense accuracy by up to 1.9 points, and improves extractive recall over GDN-2. At 1.34B, Muir outperforms both baselines on multi-hop and multi-needle recall, extrapolates 2,560x from its 4K training length to 10M-token streams without perplexity drift, and maintains near-100% passkey retrieval to 1M tokens with static readout. Muir achieves these gains while matching GDN-2 throughput, reaching its 100B-token validation loss 1.2x faster, and training 2.7x faster than Transformer at 32K.
items.abstract_zh: 线性注意力将上下文压缩为固定大小的键值状态，以实现线性时间训练和常量内存推理。门控 delta 规则模型会衰减该状态，并在写入新值之前擦除其对传入键的预测；Gated DeltaNet-2（GDN-2）通过逐通道衰减以及解耦的全秩擦除门和写入门对此进行推广。然而，我们表明状态更新对擦除的敏感度远低于对写入的敏感度：键激活和单位归一化将键能量集中到一小部分稀疏通道上，而值写入会缩放所有通道，因此擦除门可以用更低秩参数化。此外，慢衰减状态行累积的范数远大于快衰减行，主导无加权读出，并迫使在写入时进行更强的擦除以抑制干扰。受此分析指导，我们提出 Muir，它将所有门融合为灵敏度分配的低秩投影，用匹配滤波读出重新加权状态行，并将节省的参数重新投入到更宽的前馈网络中。由于标准分块算法在饱和宽矩阵单元所需的大分块尺寸下数值不稳定，我们设计了一种并行更新以实现稳定、高效的训练。在 166M–1.34B 参数范围内，Muir 相比 GDN-2 将困惑度降低 1.8–2.0%，相比 Transformer 降低 2.5–3.6%，将常识准确率提高最多 1.9 个点，并相比 GDN-2 提升抽取式召回。在 1.34B 参数下，Muir 在多跳和多针召回上均优于两个基线，从其 4K 训练长度外推到 10M token 流而困惑度不漂移，并在静态读出下对 1M token 保持接近 100% 的 passkey 检索。Muir 在实现这些增益的同时匹配 GDN-2 吞吐量，以 1.2 倍更快达到其 100B token 验证损失，并在 32K 下比 Transformer 训练快 2.7 倍。

items.title_en: Agent-R$^2$: Scaling Agents for Realistic Productivity Work via Real-Source Data Synthesis
items.title_zh: Agent-R$^2$：通过真实来源数据合成扩展智能体以完成现实生产力工作
items.abstract_en: Large language models have made rapid progress in agentic reasoning and tool use, raising expectations for agents that can take over realistic productivity work from humans. However, current agents still struggle to finish such tasks, where success requires following long-horizon professional workflows, understanding heterogeneous file contexts, and producing usable deliverables under fine-grained requirements. A key bottleneck is the lack of scalable post-training data that reflects real work intent, authentic file environments, and deliverable-level evaluation. To close this gap, we introduce Agent-R$^2$, a $\textbf{r}$eal-source data synthesis framework that scales training data for $\textbf{r}$ealistic productivity work. Instead of relying on manually specified workflows or LLM-generated files, Agent-R$^2$ grounds synthesis throughout the pipeline in real occupational seeds, corpus-derived workflow evidence, and authentic web-sourced files. From 10k web-corpus candidates, Agent-R$^2$ distills 4k task instances that pair real multi-format attachments with fine-grained, deliverable-level rubrics. On this data, we train Agent-R$^2$-4B via supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning, improving both end-to-end productivity performance and file-grounded reasoning. Trained on only 4k instances, Agent-R$^2$-4B surpasses Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 on both GDPval (51.0$\%$ vs. 48.0$\%$) and OfficeQA (14.8$\%$ vs. 13.8$\%$). Further analysis shows that Agent-R$^2$ mitigates shortcut behavior, where agents produce superficially plausible deliverables before sufficiently grounding, constructing, or verifying them, while promoting sustained exploration.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在智能体推理和工具使用方面已取得快速进展，提升了人们对智能体能够接管人类现实生产力工作的期望。然而，当前智能体仍难以完成此类任务，成功需要遵循长时程专业工作流、理解异构文件上下文，并在细粒度要求下产出可交付成果。一个关键瓶颈是缺乏可扩展的后训练数据，这些数据应反映真实工作意图、真实文件环境和交付物级评估。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 Agent-R$^2$，一个真实来源（real-source）数据合成框架，用于为现实生产力（realistic productivity work）扩展训练数据。Agent-R$^2$ 不依赖人工指定的工作流或 LLM 生成的文件，而是在整个流程中以真实职业种子、语料库衍生的工作流证据和真实网络来源文件为基础进行合成。从 10k 网络语料候选者中，Agent-R$^2$ 蒸馏出 4k 个任务实例，这些实例将真实多格式附件与细粒度、交付物级评分标准配对。在这些数据上，我们通过监督微调和基于评分标准的强化学习训练 Agent-R$^2$-4B，提升端到端生产力性能和基于文件的推理。仅用 4k 个实例训练，Agent-R$^2$-4B 在 GDPval（51.0% 对 48.0%）和 OfficeQA（14.8% 对 13.8%）上均超过 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507。进一步分析表明，Agent-R$^2$ 缓解了捷径行为，即智能体在充分接地、构建或验证之前就产出表面看似合理的交付物，同时促进持续探索。

items.title_en: OopsieRecover: Learning Transferable VLA Corrections from Semantic Interventions
items.title_zh: OopsieRecover：从语义干预中学习可迁移的 VLA 纠正
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform a wide range of robotic manipulation tasks, but often fail during deployment. Teaching them to recover from these failures requires substantial corrective data: existing approaches learn to recover from failures by directly associating corrective actions with the observations in which they were demonstrated. For instance, DAgger-like fine-tuning can require tens to hundreds of interactions, yet the resulting policy may still fail to generalize the learned corrections beyond the demonstrated scenarios. We hypothesize that semantics can capture the underlying reasons for failures and their corrections, enabling policies to learn from only a handful of corrective demonstrations and generalize those corrections to novel objects, and scene variations. We propose OopsieRecover, a framework that uses abduction to infer the intent behind a small set of corrective demonstrations and encodes the inferred knowledge as dense spatial representations and conditional costs. These costs capture when a behavior is undesirable and steer the policy toward more desirable action regions. We experiment across 6 tasks and variations in object poses, scenes, and related tasks, and find that only a handful of corrective demonstrations can enable a VLA to overcome failures across a broad range of novel situations, without requiring new corrective data for each variation. Please refer to https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsierecover for videos.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可以执行广泛的机器人操作任务，但在部署期间经常失败。教会它们从这些失败中恢复需要大量纠正数据：现有方法通过将纠正动作与其被演示时的观测直接关联来学习从失败中恢复。例如，类似 DAgger 的微调可能需要数十到数百次交互，而所得策略仍可能无法将学到的纠正泛化到演示场景之外。我们假设语义可以捕捉失败及其纠正的潜在原因，使策略仅从少量纠正演示中学习，并将这些纠正泛化到新物体和场景变化。我们提出 OopsieRecover，一个使用溯因推理（abduction）推断一小组纠正演示背后意图的框架，并将推断出的知识编码为稠密空间表示和条件成本。这些成本捕捉行为何时不可取，并引导策略朝向更可取的动作区域。我们在 6 个任务以及物体位姿、场景和相关任务变化上进行实验，发现仅需少量纠正演示即可使 VLA 在广泛的新情况下克服失败，而无需为每种变化收集新的纠正数据。视频见 https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsierecover。

items.title_en: Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model
items.title_zh: Concertina：在一个扩散视觉-语言模型中同时体现操作与认知
items.abstract_en: Most vision-language-action (VLA) policies decouple manipulation from cognition by bolting an external action mechanism onto a vision-language model (VLM)--either quantizing actions into discrete tokens whose errors bear no stable correspondence to physical displacements, or delegating continuous trajectory generation to a separate action expert whose gradients compete with or are blocked from updating the VLM backbone. We argue that manipulation and cognition should instead be embodied in the same model, shifting from a decoupled VLA to an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM). We introduce Concertina, an eVLM that places continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly on the computation and parameter path of a shared diffusion VLM backbone. Each control timestep is encoded as one continuous latent action token in the backbone hidden space, and the shared Transformer reconstructs temporally ordered action blocks via the same corrupt-and-reconstruct operator used for multimodal pretraining. Active action projections account for only 0.21% of parameters in the 4.46B model with zero separate action-generator layers, compared with 16.5%-35.1% dedicated action-expert capacity in representative continuous VLAs. Using our proposed Action Interface Audit, we confirm that cross-time trajectory coupling emerges in the middle and late layers of the shared backbone rather than at the action interfaces. On standard benchmarks, Concertina achieves 98.15% average success on regular LIBERO, 85.9% on the 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus benchmark, and 4.142 average completed chain length on CALVIN ABC-D. Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina
items.abstract_zh: 大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过将外部动作机制附加到视觉-语言模型（VLM）上来将操作与认知解耦——要么将动作量化为离散 token，其误差与物理位移没有稳定的对应关系；要么将连续轨迹生成委托给单独的动作专家，其梯度与 VLM 主干竞争或被阻止更新主干。我们认为，操作与认知应当体现在同一个模型中，即从解耦的 VLA 转向具身视觉-语言模型（eVLM）。我们提出 Concertina，一种 eVLM，它将连续轨迹表示、分块生成和物理坐标监督直接置于共享扩散 VLM 主干的 computation and parameter path 上。每个控制时间步被编码为主干隐藏空间中的一个连续潜在动作 token，共享 Transformer 通过与多模态预训练相同的 corrupt-and-reconstruct 算子重建按时间排序的动作块。在 4.46B 模型中，活跃动作投影仅占参数的 0.21%，且没有任何单独的动作生成器层；相比之下，代表性连续 VLA 中专用动作专家的容量为 16.5%–35.1%。使用我们提出的 Action Interface Audit，我们确认跨时间轨迹耦合出现在共享主干的中层和深层，而不是出现在动作接口处。在标准基准上，Concertina 在常规 LIBERO 上取得 98.15% 的平均成功率，在包含 10,030 个任务的 LIBERO-Plus 基准上取得 85.9%，在 CALVIN ABC-D 上平均完成链长为 4.142。代码：https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face：https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina

items.title_en: Molecular typing and characterisation of antimicrobial resistance determinants of Neisseria gonorrhoeae among symptomatic individuals in the Eastern Cape, South Africa
items.title_zh: 南非东开普省有症状个体中淋病奈瑟菌的分子分型及抗菌药物耐药决定因素特征
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Background. Antimicrobial resistance in Neisseria gonorrhoeae threatens gonorrhoea treatment, while surveillance is constrained by limited culture capacity. We evaluated multi-antigen sequence typing (NG-MAST) and targeted real-time PCR for molecular epidemiology and detection of antimicrobial resistance-associated determinants directly from clinical specimens. Methods. We analysed 235 N. gonorrhoeae-positive stored DNA extracts from symptomatic individuals in South Africa. NG-MAST sequence types were obtained directly or from whole-genome sequences (WGS) of paired cultured isolates. Real-time PCR targeted quinolone resistance-associated mutations (RAMs) in parC and gyrA and macrolide RAMs in the 23S rRNA gene. Results were compared with WGS and with phenotypic susceptibility results from paired isolates. Results. NG-MAST sequence types were obtained for 200/235 (85.1%) specimens and were diverse, with ST21253 predominating (n=26). At least one gyrA or parC mutation was detected by real-time PCR in 110/193 (57.0%) specimens. Compared with WGS, positive agreement was 81.2% for parC and 97.0% for gyrA, and negative agreement 100% and 95.8%, respectively. Among 65 ciprofloxacin-resistant isolates, RAMs were detected in 60 (92.3%) by real-time PCR and 61 (93.8%) by WGS; four had no RAM detected by either method. The 23S rRNA C2611T mutation was detected by both methods in one isolate (azithromycin MIC, 8 mg/L); no A2059G mutations were detected. Conclusions. Gonococcal sequence types were diverse, quinolone RAMs were common, and the assessed macrolide RAMs were rare. Real-time PCR applied directly to specimen DNA agreed well with WGS, but the targeted markers did not fully predict ciprofloxacin susceptibility, supporting complementary molecular and phenotypic approaches. Key words: Neisseria gonorrhoeae, NG-MAST, Real-time PCR, WGS; quinolone resistance; ciprofloxacin resistance, macrolide resistance
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景。淋病奈瑟菌的抗菌药物耐药性威胁淋病治疗，而监测受限于培养能力。我们评估了多抗原序列分型（NG-MAST）和靶向实时 PCR 在分子流行病学以及直接从临床标本中检测抗菌药物耐药相关决定因素方面的作用。方法。我们分析了来自南非有症状个体的 235 份淋病奈瑟菌阳性保存 DNA 提取物。NG-MAST 序列型直接从 DNA 中获得，或从配对培养分离株的全基因组序列（WGS）中获得。实时 PCR 靶向 parC 和 gyrA 中的喹诺酮耐药相关突变（RAMs）以及 23S rRNA 基因中的大环内酯类 RAMs。结果与 WGS 以及配对分离株的表型药敏结果进行了比较。结果。在 200/235（85.1%）份标本中获得了 NG-MAST 序列型，且具有多样性，以 ST21253 为主（n=26）。实时 PCR 在 110/193（57.0%）份标本中检出至少一个 gyrA 或 parC 突变。与 WGS 相比，parC 的阳性一致率为 81.2%，gyrA 为 97.0%，阴性一致率分别为 100% 和 95.8%。在 65 株环丙沙星耐药分离株中，实时 PCR 检出 RAMs 的有 60 株（92.3%），WGS 检出 61 株（93.8%）；4 株在两种方法中均未检出 RAM。两种方法在一株分离株中均检出 23S rRNA C2611T 突变（阿奇霉素 MIC 为 8 mg/L）；未检出 A2059G 突变。结论。淋球菌序列型具有多样性，喹诺酮 RAMs 常见，所评估的大环内酯类 RAMs 罕见。直接应用于标本 DNA 的实时 PCR 与 WGS 一致性良好，但靶向标志物不能完全预测环丙沙星敏感性，支持分子与表型方法互补。关键词：淋病奈瑟菌，NG-MAST，实时 PCR，WGS；喹诺酮耐药；环丙沙星耐药，大环内酯类耐药

items.title_en: A Passive Intelligent Metasurface: A Network Model
items.title_zh: 一种无源智能超表面：网络模型
items.abstract_en: Intelligent metasurfaces enable advanced wave manipulation, including negative refraction, focusing, beam splitting and beam steering, with significant potential for practical applications. However, conventional approaches often rely on active metamaterials with gain, or demand computationally intensive solutions of inverse problems to find the optimal configuration. In this work, we use the scattering framework of quantum graph theory to derive an exact, analytic expression for configuration of a passive metasurface that produces a prescribed reflected wave field. The metasurface terminates a periodic lattice of waveguides and consists of an array of channels, each a tube of length $\ell_m$ ending in a vertex whose scattering parameter $λ_m$ sets how much of the wave is lost to the wall. For any prescribed incident and reflected field, the exact lengths and scattering parameters follow channel by channel, in closed form, from the ratio of the wave amplitudes returning to and leaving the lattice, and the metasurface is passive whenever this ratio does not exceed unity in modulus. We demonstrate the construction for both a one-dimensional and a two-dimensional metasurface. The one-dimensional metasurface terminates a two-dimensional lattice and steers, splits or perfectly absorbs Gaussian beams. The two-dimensional metasurface terminates a three-dimensional lattice and generates a prescribed image in a plane inside the lattice. In each case, we obtain the exact boundary properties that produce the effect.
items.abstract_zh: 智能超表面能够实现先进的波操控，包括负折射、聚焦、分束和波束偏转，具有重要的实际应用潜力。然而，传统方法往往依赖带有增益的有源超材料，或需要计算密集地求解逆问题以找到最优配置。在本工作中，我们使用量子图论的散射框架，推导出可产生指定反射波场的无源超表面配置的精确解析表达式。该超表面端接周期波导晶格，由一组通道组成，每个通道是一根长度为 $\ell_m$ 的管，末端为一个顶点，其散射参数 $\lambda_m$ 决定有多少波损失到壁中。对于任意给定的入射场和反射场，精确的长度和散射参数可逐通道地由返回晶格和离开晶格的波振幅之比以闭式形式得到，且当该比值的模不超过 1 时，超表面是无源的。我们演示了一维和二维超表面的构造。一维超表面端接二维晶格，可对高斯光束进行偏转、分束或完美吸收。二维超表面端接三维晶格，并在晶格内部的平面上生成指定图像。在每种情况下，我们都获得了产生该效果的精确边界性质。

items.title_en: User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes
items.title_zh: 用户嵌入是可解释行为模式的叠加
items.abstract_en: User embeddings are central components of modern recommendation, personalization, and behavioral modeling systems. Though these embeddings can compactly encode rich behavioral information, they are inherently dense and opaque, limiting interpretability. To address this gap, we argue that user embeddings can be understood as sparse superpositions of interpretable behavioral modes. This structure is directly predicted by generative models of user behavior for linear embeddings and extends approximately to deep-learning representations by the superposition hypothesis. Superimposed modes can naturally be recovered by sparse dictionary learning methods, such as sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and recovered modes can be automatically named and queried in natural language. We validate mode recovery against known ground truth on synthetic data, where SAEs recover modes better than classical sparse baselines, including on transformer-encoded embeddings. We then apply the method to classical and transformer-based user embeddings from two real-world datasets. We also show how the corresponding natural-language labels enable zero-shot audience retrieval and characterization over embeddings never trained on text. The framework is post-hoc and model-agnostic, requiring no modification to the upstream embedding system.
items.abstract_zh: 用户嵌入是现代推荐、个性化和行为建模系统的核心组件。虽然这些嵌入可以紧凑地编码丰富的行为信息，但它们本质上是稠密且不透明的，限制了可解释性。为弥补这一空白，我们认为用户嵌入可以理解为可解释行为模式的稀疏叠加。对于线性嵌入，这一结构可由用户行为的生成模型直接预测，并通过叠加假说近似扩展到深度学习表示。叠加的模式可以自然地通过稀疏字典学习方法恢复，例如稀疏自编码器（SAEs），并且恢复的模式可以用自然语言自动命名和查询。我们在合成数据上以已知的真实基准验证模式恢复，其中 SAEs 比经典稀疏基线恢复得更好，包括在 Transformer 编码的嵌入上。随后我们将该方法应用于来自两个真实世界数据集的经典用户嵌入和基于 Transformer 的用户嵌入。我们还展示了相应的自然语言标签如何实现零样本受众检索，以及对从未用文本训练过的嵌入进行表征。该框架是事后的且与模型无关，无需修改上游嵌入系统。

items.title_en: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
items.title_zh: 知道何时教：在多语言推理蒸馏中从可教前缀学习
items.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a student on its own reasoning, using the same model conditioned on reference solutions as a teacher. Applying OPSD to multilingual reasoning requires the teacher to provide useful feedback across languages, even when the student makes mistakes in intermediate steps. We observe a phenomenon we call Teacher Drift: as these mistakes accumulate, the teacher may follow the student's incorrect steps instead of correcting them. Our analysis shows that this shift tends to occur earlier in lower-resource languages. To account for these differences across languages, we propose Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation (TOPSD), which determines where and whether teacher supervision should be applied to each reasoning trajectory. TOPSD uses teacher-student likelihood to estimate where drift begins and select a prefix for supervision. It then verifies whether the teacher can recover the correct answer from that prefix, applying distillation only to prefixes that pass verification. Experiments on multilingual mathematical reasoning across ten languages and three model scales show that TOPSD consistently outperforms conventional OPSD, particularly in low- and medium-resource languages.
items.abstract_zh: 同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过在学生自身的推理上训练学生来提升推理能力，使用以参考解答为条件的同一模型作为教师。将 OPSD 应用于多语言推理要求教师能够跨语言提供有用的反馈，即使学生在中间步骤出错。我们观察到一种称为教师漂移（Teacher Drift）的现象：随着这些错误累积，教师可能跟随学生的错误步骤而不是纠正它们。我们的分析表明，这种转变在低资源语言中往往更早发生。为应对跨语言的这些差异，我们提出可教同策略自蒸馏（TOPSD），它决定在每条推理轨迹上应在何处以及是否应用教师监督。TOPSD 使用教师-学生似然估计漂移开始的位置并选择用于监督的前缀。然后它验证教师能否从该前缀恢复正确答案，仅对通过验证的前缀应用蒸馏。在十种语言和三种模型规模上的多语言数学推理实验表明，TOPSD 始终优于传统 OPSD，尤其是在低资源和中资源语言中。

items.title_en: GPWM: Modeling the World as 3D Particle Motion
items.title_zh: GPWM：将世界建模为3D粒子运动
items.abstract_en: We introduce GPWM, a Generative Particle World Model that predicts how 3D scenes evolve by generating the motion of particles and rigid bodies over time. Unlike video world models that generate scene appearance, GPWM operates directly in 3D physical space. A single representation and architecture cover rigid, deformable, cloth, and granular materials, in both passive physics and robotic interaction. GPWM is an object-aware multi-resolution transformer that combines flow matching with diffusion forcing to generate coherent physical trajectories far beyond its training horizon. We train and evaluate GPWM on ParticleWorlds, a 25.5-million-frame corpus spanning diverse geometries, materials, interactions, and robot embodiments. GPWM outperforms the best prior learned-dynamics baseline in each of six physical domains, reducing prediction error by 31% on average. Breaking from the domain-specific setting of prior methods, a single Unified GPWM models these heterogeneous regimes with one set of weights, largely outperforming per-domain baselines and even surpassing our own specialist models in two domains. GPWM further generalizes to unseen geometries, physical properties, object counts, and rollout horizons. Beyond prediction, GPWM enables contact-rich planning by learning a generative prior over joint actuator-object motion. Instead of searching over unconstrained actions, planning searches the model's latent noise for interactions that achieve a desired object-space goal. With the same world model, noise-space planning substantially outperforms action-space search on pushing and picking, where complex contact sequences are hard to discover. Executed open-loop in simulation, the resulting plans achieve goal-directed manipulation without reference action trajectories or goal-specific policies.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出GPWM生成式粒子世界模型，通过生成粒子与刚体随时间的运动来预测3D场景演化。与生成场景外观的视频世界模型不同，GPWM直接工作在3D物理空间，用单一表示和架构覆盖刚性、可变形、布料和颗粒材料，兼顾被动物理与机器人交互。GPWM是对象感知的多分辨率Transformer，结合flow matching与diffusion forcing，可生成远超训练时长的连贯物理轨迹。作者在ParticleWorlds（2550万帧，涵盖多样几何、材料、交互和机器人形态）上训练和评估：GPWM在六个物理域均优于最佳先验学习动力学基线，平均降低31%预测误差；统一GPWM用一套权重建模这些异质情形，大幅优于分域基线，并在两个域超过专家模型，还能泛化到未见几何、物性、物体数量和推演时长。在规划方面，GPWM学习执行器—物体联合运动的生成先验，在模型潜噪声中搜索而非动作空间搜索，在推与抓取上明显优于动作空间搜索。
items.highlight_zh: 用3D粒子运动生成统一建模多材质世界
items.digest_zh: 1）问题：视频世界模型主要生成场景外观，而非直接建模3D物理演化；不同材质和机器人交互常需专门模型。2）方法：提出GPWM生成式粒子世界模型，直接在3D物理空间生成粒子与刚体随时间的运动，用单一表示覆盖刚性、可变形、布料和颗粒材料，兼顾被动物理与机器人交互。3）架构与数据：采用对象感知的多分辨率Transformer，结合flow matching与diffusion forcing，在ParticleWorlds（2550万帧）上训练，能生成超出训练时长的连贯物理轨迹。4）结果：在六个物理域均优于最佳先验学习动力学基线，平均降低31%预测误差；统一GPWM用一套权重大幅优于分域基线，并在两个域超过专家模型，还能泛化到未见几何、物性、物体数量和推演时长。5）规划：利用执行器—物体联合运动的生成先验，在模型潜噪声中搜索而非动作空间搜索，在推与抓取上优于动作空间搜索，仿真开环执行即可完成目标导向操作。6）意义：为物理AI提供统一、可规划的3D世界模型。

items.title_en: Wide View Synthesis from Overlapping Perspective Cameras in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 自动驾驶中基于重叠透视相机的宽视角合成
items.abstract_en: Multi-perspective-camera systems are widely adopted since they provide broad visual coverage for autonomous driving, motivating the synthesis of a unified wide view from spatially separated observations. In this work, we formulate wide view synthesis (WVS), which aims to synthesize a geometrically consistent wide view at a specified virtual viewpoint from multiple perspective cameras. Unlike conventional image stitching, WVS requires reasoning about 3D geometry and visibility to handle depth-dependent parallax and occlusions arising from spatially separated camera centers. While vanilla 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity view synthesis, its reliance on per-scene optimization limits its applicability to driving scenes. Furthermore, WVS introduces additional challenges, *e.g.*, peripheral stretching under perspective projection and photometric inconsistencies across cameras. To address these challenges, we propose **Wide-View Gaussian Splatting (WV-GS)**, a feed-forward Gaussian-splatting framework that synthesizes wide views without per-scene optimization. Specifically, we introduce Piecewise Perspective Rendering (PPR) to mitigate peripheral stretching through local perspective projections sharing a common camera center, and Spatial Affine Photometric Modeling (SAPM) to account for camera-dependent photometric variations during training. We further introduce **WideDrive**, a synthetic benchmark providing dense ground-truth wide views and adapt a LiDAR-projected sparse-reference protocol to real-world datasets. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of WV-GS for WVS. Dataset and code will be publicly released.
items.abstract_zh: 多透视相机系统被广泛采用，因为它们为自动驾驶提供广阔的视觉覆盖，这推动了从空间分离的观测中合成统一宽视角。在这项工作中，我们形式化了宽视角合成（WVS），其目标是从多个透视相机在指定虚拟视点处合成几何一致的宽视角。与传统图像拼接不同，WVS 需要推理 3D 几何和可见性，以处理由空间分离的相机中心引起的深度相关视差和遮挡。虽然原始 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）能够实现高保真视角合成，但其对逐场景优化的依赖限制了其在驾驶场景中的适用性。此外，WVS 引入了额外挑战，例如透视投影下的周边拉伸和跨相机的光度不一致。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Wide-View Gaussian Splatting（WV-GS），一种无需逐场景优化即可合成宽视角的前馈高斯泼溅框架。具体而言，我们引入 Piecewise Perspective Rendering（PPR），通过共享共同相机中心的局部透视投影来减轻周边拉伸，并引入 Spatial Affine Photometric Modeling（SAPM），以在训练期间考虑相机相关的光度变化。我们进一步引入 WideDrive，一个提供密集真值宽视角的合成基准，并将 LiDAR 投影的稀疏参考协议适配到真实世界数据集。在多个数据集上的大量实验证明了 WV-GS 对 WVS 的有效性。数据集和代码将公开。

items.title_en: Single-cell profiling of human plaques reveals cellular and molecular signatures of symptomatic atherosclerosis
items.title_zh: 人类斑块的单细胞分析揭示症状性动脉粥样硬化的细胞和分子特征
items.abstract_en: Atherosclerotic plaque vulnerability drives ischemic cardiovascular events, yet the cellular and molecular signatures distinguishing symptomatic from asymptomatic human plaques remain poorly defined. Here, we compared 53 symptomatic and asymptomatic human carotid plaques using single-nucleus (snRNA-seq; 17 samples, 19,100 nuclei; AtherOMICS biobank) and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq; 36 samples, 68,983 cells; four public datasets), analyzed independently and combined by meta-analysis. Across sequencing approaches, symptomatic plaques showed cell-state shifts toward later or terminal states in osteochondrogenic smooth muscle cells (SMCs) and CD4 T cells, as well as transcriptional changes toward inflammatory and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in endothelial cells (ECs), T cells, and fibroblasts. Nuclear profiling uncovered a depletion of fibroblasts in symptomatic plaques, marked by downregulation of RGS5. Integrating these transcriptomic signatures with genome-wide association data for coronary, cerebrovascular, and peripheral atherosclerotic disease, we found that genetic risk was enriched primarily in vascular wall cells (SMCs, fibroblasts, ECs), rather than immune cell types. The analyses further nominated higher TWIST1 expression in ECs (colocalized with risk across four atherosclerotic phenotypes), lower GUCY1A1 expression in fibroblasts and macrophages, and higher MRAS expression in T cells as candidate driver mechanisms linking genetic risk to symptomatic plaque transition. These findings provide novel insights into cellular and molecular phenotypes associated with plaque vulnerability and identify potential driver mechanisms of symptomatic plaque transformation that could inform therapeutic development.
items.abstract_zh: 动脉粥样硬化斑块易损性驱动缺血性心血管事件，但区分症状性与无症状性人类斑块的细胞和分子特征仍定义不清。在此，我们比较了 53 个症状性和无症状性人类颈动脉斑块，使用单核 RNA 测序（snRNA-seq；17 个样本，19,100 个细胞核；AtherOMICS 生物样本库）和单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq；36 个样本，68,983 个细胞；四个公共数据集），分别独立分析并通过荟萃分析合并。跨测序方法，症状性斑块显示骨软骨生成性平滑肌细胞（SMCs）和 CD4 T 细胞向较晚或终末状态的细胞状态转变，以及内皮细胞（ECs）、T 细胞和成纤维细胞中向炎症和上皮-间质转化（EMT）的转录变化。细胞核分析发现症状性斑块中成纤维细胞耗竭，以 RGS5 下调为标志。将这些转录组特征与冠状动脉、脑血管和外周动脉粥样硬化疾病的全基因组关联数据整合，我们发现遗传风险主要富集于血管壁细胞（SMCs、成纤维细胞、ECs），而非免疫细胞类型。分析进一步提名 ECs 中较高的 TWIST1 表达（与四种动脉粥样硬化表型的风险共定位）、成纤维细胞和巨噬细胞中较低的 GUCY1A1 表达，以及 T 细胞中较高的 MRAS 表达，作为将遗传风险与症状性斑块转变联系起来的候选驱动机制。这些发现为与斑块易损性相关的细胞和分子表型提供了新见解，并识别了症状性斑块转化的潜在驱动机制，可为治疗开发提供信息。

items.title_en: Development of time-resolved fluorescence spectroscopy using heralded emission spectroscopy for organic light-emitting materials
items.title_zh: 用于有机发光材料的基于预报发射光谱的时间分辨荧光光谱开发
items.abstract_en: Organic light-emitting materials are widely used in optoelectronics and bioimaging, but sometimes conventional fluorescence spectroscopy techniques can be limited by scattering, background fluorescence, photon pile-up and photobleaching. We report a quantum-spectroscopic approach using frequency-entangled, nondegenerate photon pairs generated via spontaneous parametric down-conversion with heralded detection, to perform photoluminescence lifetime measurements at low excitation intensities. We demonstrate this approach across three organic light-emitting material classes: the fluorescent dye Rhodamine 6G, an organic semiconducting conjugated polymer poly[2-methoxy-5-(2-ethylhexyloxy)-1,4-phenylenevinylene] (MEH-PPV), and a fluorescent protein mOrange. The intrinsic timing correlation between signal and idler photons enables coincidence gating that suppresses uncorrelated background counts. Across all materials and integration times of 500, 1000 and 3600 seconds, heralded detection yields signal-to-noise ratios 1.6-3.0 times higher than classical pulsed-laser excitation attenuated to match heralded photon counts in the fitting range. For MEH-PPV, this roughly halves the noise amplitude. Our measured lifetimes closely match long-integration classical pulsed-laser reference values.
items.abstract_zh: 有机发光材料广泛用于光电子学和生物成像，但传统荧光光谱技术有时会受到散射、背景荧光、光子堆积和光漂白的限制。我们报告一种量子光谱方法，使用通过自发参量下转换产生的频率纠缠非简并光子对并结合预报探测，在低激发强度下进行光致发光寿命测量。我们在三类有机发光材料上演示了该方法：荧光染料罗丹明 6G、有机半导体共轭聚合物聚[2-甲氧基-5-(2-乙基己氧基)-1,4-亚苯基亚乙烯基]（MEH-PPV）和荧光蛋白 mOrange。信号光子和闲频光子之间的内在时间相关性使得符合门控能够抑制不相关背景计数。在所有材料和 500、1000 和 3600 秒的积分时间下，预报探测产生的信噪比比经衰减以在拟合范围内匹配预报光子计数的经典脉冲激光激发高 1.6–3.0 倍。对于 MEH-PPV，这大约使噪声幅度减半。我们测得的寿命与长积分经典脉冲激光参考值密切匹配。

items.title_en: Spectral and Subspace Dynamics of LoRA in Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 监督微调与强化学习中 LoRA 的谱与子空间动力学
items.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is commonly used in both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), often under similar optimizer settings. Yet, how the different dynamics of the two stages manifest in the low-rank increment that LoRA optimizes remains unclear. Tracking the singular spectrum and subspaces of LoRA updates on mathematical reasoning tasks, we find that RL concentrates the spectrum at every learning rate, while SFT expands it at moderate learning rates; moreover, RL rotates the singular subspaces much faster than SFT at small learning rates. Interpolating between SFT and RL one ingredient at a time, we pinpoint group-mean baseline subtraction as the source of both contrasts. A quadratic multi-index model updated via LoRA unveils the underlying mechanism: group-mean baseline subtraction tilts the balance between two competing forces, coherent fitting and gradient noise, toward spectral concentration and faster subspace rotation, while forcing the risk-favorable learning rate to be low. Guided by these dynamics, we tailor LoRA updates to each stage: in SFT, we flatten the spectrum of the full update to spread adaptation across singular directions, whereas in RL, we flatten the part of the update outside the current LoRA increment span to promote subspace rotation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks across multiple models show that the respective configurations for SFT and RL yield the best performance among the compared methods in most evaluated settings.
items.abstract_zh: 低秩适应（LoRA）常用于监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL），且通常在相似的优化器设置下使用。然而，这两个阶段的不同动力学如何体现在 LoRA 优化的低秩增量中仍不清楚。通过跟踪数学推理任务上 LoRA 更新的奇异谱和子空间，我们发现 RL 在每个学习率下都会集中谱，而 SFT 在中等学习率下会扩展谱；此外，在小学习率下，RL 旋转奇异子空间的速度远快于 SFT。逐一在 SFT 和 RL 之间进行要素插值，我们确定组均值基线减法（group-mean baseline subtraction）是这两种对比的来源。通过 LoRA 更新的二次多指标模型揭示了潜在机制：组均值基线减法使两种竞争力量——相干拟合和梯度噪声——之间的平衡倾向于谱集中和更快的子空间旋转，同时迫使风险有利的学习率变低。在这些动力学指导下，我们为每个阶段定制 LoRA 更新：在 SFT 中，我们展平完整更新的谱，以将适应分布到奇异方向；而在 RL 中，我们展平更新中当前 LoRA 增量跨度之外的部分，以促进子空间旋转。在多个模型上的数学推理任务实验表明，在大多数评估设置中，SFT 和 RL 各自的配置在比较方法中产生了最佳性能。

items.title_en: Automatic keyphrase extraction and annotation: modern theoretical approaches and practical solutions for text and speech
items.title_zh: 自动关键词提取与标注：面向文本和语音的现代理论方法与实践解决方案
items.abstract_en: The exponential growth of textual and audiovisual information has made the task of automatic keyphrase extraction (KE) increasingly significant. This article provides a comprehensive analysis of contemporary theoretical approaches and practical solutions for KE across both text and speech modalities. The primary contribution of this work is its systematic synthesis of these often-disparate research strands into a unified analytical framework, highlighting the evolution of the field from statistical methods towards large language models (LLMs) and end-to-end speech processing. We examine the stages of KE, the characteristics of keyphrases in written and spoken language, and terminological nuances. Various methods for automatic KE are discussed and analyzed in detail: statistical, hybrid, machine learning-based, and structural. The review dedicates substantial attention to emerging paradigms, including keyphrase generation using LLMs, and provides a detailed overview of methodologies and challenges in automatic corpus annotation. Furthermore, we specifically analyze current directions and inherent difficulties in KE for spoken language, comparing transcript based and end-to-end acoustic approaches. This synthesis leads us to conclude that the field is moving towards a more integrated, context-aware paradigm. Future progress will depend on addressing key challenges such as data scarcity for low-resource languages, effective multimodal fusion, and the nuanced evaluation of generative KE systems.
items.abstract_zh: 文本和视听信息的指数增长使自动关键词提取（KE）任务日益重要。本文全面分析了跨文本和语音模态的 KE 的当代理论方法和实践解决方案。这项工作的主要贡献在于将这些通常分散的研究脉络系统性地综合为一个统一分析框架，突出该领域从统计方法向大语言模型（LLMs）和端到端语音处理的演变。我们考察 KE 的阶段、书面和口语中关键词的特征以及术语细微差别。详细讨论和分析了各种自动 KE 方法：统计、混合、基于机器学习和结构化方法。综述相当关注新兴范式，包括使用 LLMs 的关键词生成，并详细概述自动语料标注的方法和挑战。此外，我们专门分析口语 KE 的当前方向和固有困难，比较基于转录和端到端声学方法。这一综合使我们得出结论：该领域正朝着更集成、上下文感知的范式发展。未来进展将取决于应对关键挑战，如低资源语言的数据稀缺、有效的多模态融合以及对生成式 KE 系统的细致评估。

items.title_en: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
items.title_zh: 面向低功耗机器人自主性的能量感知开放词汇检测调度
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings. A separate 60 s stationary microbenchmark isolates the perception workload: the scheduler lowers mean power from 8.045 W to 7.301 W and energy from 484.7 J to 438.1 J relative to the 8 Hz baseline. These results support robot-state-aware OVD scheduling as a promising power-management mechanism with competitive task reliability, while showing that mission-window Jetson input energy must be read together with task progress and runtime.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）使机器人能够搜索运行时目标查询，但固定速率推理会在空闲运动、地图重访或稳定视点期间将嵌入式计算花费在低价值帧上。本文提出一种用于低功耗移动机器人的能量感知 OVD 调度器。该调度器利用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度，在 Jetson Orin Nano 上在低、中、高功耗 YOLO-World-S 模式之间切换。我们在 AgileX LIMO 上使用 40 次真实导航试验评估能量-质量权衡：两个目标物体、每个目标-策略对五次放置以及四种感知策略。在瓶子和杯子试验中，调度器记录 8/10 任务成功，而每个固定速率基线为 7/10，同时相对于 8 Hz 高速率基线将平均 Jetson 输入功率（一种 Jetson 侧功耗指标）降低 5.2%，并将实现的 OVD 调用率降低 34.0%。它并未最小化任务窗口内的 Jetson 输入能量，因为更长的任务可能抵消瞬时功率节省。一个单独的 60 秒静止微基准隔离感知工作负载：相对于 8 Hz 基线，调度器将平均功率从 8.045 W 降至 7.301 W，能量从 484.7 J 降至 438.1 J。这些结果支持机器人状态感知的 OVD 调度作为一种有前景的功率管理机制，具有有竞争力的任务可靠性，同时表明任务窗口内的 Jetson 输入能量必须与任务进度和运行时间一起解读。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续的5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置的体积密度和与视图相关的发射辐射。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机姿态的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Accounting for Insulin-on-board in Large Language Model Advice about Pediatric Hyperglycemia
items.title_zh: 在关于儿童高血糖的大型语言模型建议中考虑体内胰岛素（insulin-on-board）
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can be used by patients and caregivers to answer medical questions and the characterization of safety concerns in LLM outputs for patient-facing applications is an active area of research. In this work, we study LLM responses to caregiver questions about hyperglycemia in pediatric type 1 diabetes. We measure the frequency of a potential safety failure: advice to dose insulin in the absence of a clear warning to account for insulin-on-board. We found occurrences of the potential safety failure across four LLMs tested through programmatic endpoints and two LLMs tested through chat interfaces. The rates of the potential safety failure varied when different context was given about the patient's meal and insulin history and treatment regimen. These results highlight a need for guardrails for patients with diabetes who use LLMs to manage their care.
items.abstract_zh: 患者和照护者可以使用大型语言模型（LLM）回答医学问题，而面向患者应用的 LLM 输出中安全问题的表征是一个活跃的研究领域。在这项工作中，我们研究 LLM 对儿童 1 型糖尿病高血糖相关照护者问题的回答。我们测量了一种潜在安全失效的频率：在没有明确警告要考虑体内胰岛素（insulin-on-board）的情况下建议给予胰岛素剂量。我们在通过程序化端点测试的四个 LLM 和通过聊天界面测试的两个 LLM 中发现了这种潜在安全失效的发生。当提供关于患者进餐和胰岛素历史及治疗方案的不同背景信息时，潜在安全失效的发生率有所不同。这些结果凸显了为使用 LLM 管理自身照护的糖尿病患者设置防护措施的必要性。

items.title_en: Unified design of short mode-evolution couplers
items.title_zh: 短模式演化耦合器的统一设计
items.abstract_en: Short mode-evolution couplers have been designed with several seemingly different approaches, including fast quasi-adiabatic dynamics (FAQUAD), counter-diabatic (CD) driving realized by tailoring waveguide widths and spacing, CD driving realized by axis bending, and numerical optimization of the coupler geometry. Using exact two-mode coupled-mode theory in the Kramers--Henneberger frame of the bent coupler, we show that these approaches belong to the same design space. The three geometric parameters, width difference, spacing, and axis tilt, act on the light through two functions only: the coupling strength, set by the spacing, and an effective detuning, set by the width difference and the axis curvature. The gauge, bent, and mixed realizations of a CD coupler are therefore the same device and have the same bandwidth. The bandwidth is set by the angle $χ$ between the light and the field that steers it on the Bloch sphere, integrated along the device as $\int\sin^2χdz$, and for a CD coupler this integral is set by the reference alone. This leads to a lithography-aware design rule: make the reference as adiabatic as the minimum gap allows, by narrowing its spacing at the anticrossing, and let exact CD suppress the remaining nonadiabatic coupling. In beam propagation method (BPM) simulations on a polymer platform, a 500\um{} coupler designed this way, without numerical optimization, maintains ${>}99\%$ transfer over 274~nm at a minimum edge gap of 1.05\um, compared with 150~nm for the CD coupler of a fixed-spacing reference at nearly the same gap. Particle swarm optimization of the geometry with BPM in the loop does not exceed the design rule. Three-dimensional BPM of the BCB channel waveguides also confirms these conclusions.
items.abstract_zh: 短模式演化耦合器已通过几种看似不同的方法设计，包括快速准绝热动力学（FAQUAD）、通过定制波导宽度和间距实现的反绝热（CD）驱动、通过轴弯曲实现的 CD 驱动，以及耦合器几何结构的数值优化。利用弯曲耦合器 Kramers--Henneberger 框架中的精确双模耦合模理论，我们表明这些方法属于同一设计空间。三个几何参数——宽度差、间距和轴倾斜——仅通过两个函数作用于光：由间距设定的耦合强度，以及由宽度差和轴曲率设定的有效失谐。因此，CD 耦合器的规范、弯曲和混合实现是同一器件，并具有相同的带宽。带宽由光与其在 Bloch 球面上操控光的场之间的角度 $χ$ 决定，沿器件积分为 $\int\sin^2χdz$，而对于 CD 耦合器，该积分仅由参考决定。这引出了一条光刻感知的设计规则：通过减小反交叉处的间距，使参考在最小间隙允许的范围内尽可能绝热，并让精确 CD 抑制剩余的非绝热耦合。在聚合物平台上的光束传播法（BPM）模拟中，按此方式设计且无需数值优化的 500\um{} 耦合器在 1.05\um 的最小边缘间隙下，在 274~nm 范围内保持 ${>}99\%$ 的传输，而在几乎相同间隙下，固定间距参考的 CD 耦合器为 150~nm。将 BPM 置于循环中的几何粒子群优化并未超过该设计规则。BCB 通道波导的三维 BPM 也证实了这些结论。

items.title_en: Wireless Link Scheduling with Graph Signal Diffusion
items.title_zh: 基于图信号扩散的无线链路调度
items.abstract_en: We solve long-horizon wireless link scheduling with per-link minimum transmission constraints. Fair distribution of resources across links and time steps requires stochastic scheduling, motivating a diffusion framework. Via imitation learning, we train a diffusion model to sample scheduling decisions, conditioning generation on the network topology and constraint levels. The parameterization is achieved through a U-Graph Neural Network (U-GNN) to leverage the relationship between graphs and wireless networks for learning. Our approach achieves near-optimal performance, maximizing sum rate while distributing allocations across different links over time horizons. The U-GNN-based diffusion model generalizes to requirements and network sizes unseen during training, demonstrating the robustness of the approach.
items.abstract_zh: 我们求解具有每条链路最小传输约束的长时程无线链路调度。跨链路和时间步公平分配资源需要随机调度，这促使我们采用扩散框架。通过模仿学习，我们训练扩散模型来采样调度决策，并以网络拓扑和约束水平为条件进行生成。参数化通过 U-图神经网络（U-GNN）实现，以利用图与无线网络之间的关系进行学习。我们的方法实现了接近最优的性能，在最大化总速率的同时，在时间范围内将分配分布到不同链路。基于 U-GNN 的扩散模型可泛化到训练中未见的需求和网络规模，证明了该方法的稳健性。

items.title_en: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
items.title_zh: 先生成后排序：为具身智能体学习符号目标解释
items.abstract_en: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI's output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model's own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. Multiple open source LLMs including DeepSeek-V3 chat, DeepSeek-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B were evaluated. The proposed method outperformed the baseline models including LLMs with simple prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph based approaches.
items.abstract_zh: 目标解释是将自然语言指令转换为规划器可执行的形式化符号目标。这对具身智能体至关重要，因为此处的任何错误都会传播到每个下游规划和动作步骤。要做好这一点，既需要生成合适的候选目标，也需要可靠地在其中进行选择。我们提出了一个两阶段的“先生成后排序”方法，用于具身智能体接口（EAI）中的目标解释。首先，监督微调使大型语言模型（LLM）适应 EAI 的输出约定。其次，基于错误的候选输出排序（CORE）从模型自身生成的备选输出中学习对完整输出的偏好。我们在具身智能体接口基准的家庭场景上进行了实验。评估了多个开源 LLM，包括 DeepSeek-V3 chat、DeepSeek-Reasoner、Qwen2.5-7B 和 Qwen2.5-72B。所提方法优于基线模型，包括使用简单提示、思维链和基于知识图谱方法的 LLM。

items.title_en: TwinBridge: Digital Twin-Driven Policy and Reward Transfer for Real-World Reinforcement Learning in Laboratory Robotics
items.title_zh: TwinBridge：数字孪生驱动的策略与奖励迁移，用于实验室机器人中的真实世界强化学习
items.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning offers an effective approach to precise laboratory manipulation, yet costly real-world demonstrations and limited access to dense process rewards hinder its practical application. We present TwinBridge, a digital twin-driven framework that supplies policy initialization and dense visual rewards for real-world online learning. We construct digital twins by combining 3D Gaussian splatting with physics simulation. Here, simulator states provide task events and geometric progress under physical prerequisites and ordering constraints, yielding rewards for policy pretraining with simulated demonstrations and reinforcement learning. We distill this supervision into a visual reward model. During real-world interaction, its predictions are combined with execution history to compute dense rewards for human-in-the-loop policy refinement. Across five real-world laboratory tasks, TwinBridge achieves a final mean autonomous success rate of 98% with at most 25 minutes of real-world interaction per task. Experiments show that dense rewards improve interaction efficiency over sparse rewards, and simulation-based policy initialization further accelerates learning.
items.abstract_zh: 在线强化学习为精确的实验室操作提供了一种有效方法，然而昂贵的真实世界演示以及难以获得密集过程奖励阻碍了其实际应用。我们提出 TwinBridge，一个数字孪生驱动的框架，为真实世界在线学习提供策略初始化和密集视觉奖励。我们通过将 3D 高斯泼溅与物理仿真相结合来构建数字孪生。在这里，仿真器状态在物理前提和顺序约束下提供任务事件和几何进度，从而产生用于使用模拟演示和强化学习进行策略预训练的奖励。我们将这种监督蒸馏到视觉奖励模型中。在真实世界交互期间，其预测与执行历史相结合，以计算用于人在回路策略细化的密集奖励。在五个真实世界实验室任务中，TwinBridge 实现了最终平均自主成功率 98%，每个任务最多使用 25 分钟的真实世界交互。实验表明，密集奖励相比稀疏奖励提高了交互效率，而基于仿真的策略初始化进一步加速了学习。

items.title_en: EDGAR: Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement via Synthetic Failure
items.title_zh: EDGAR：通过合成失败样本实现的高效扩散驱动高斯化身精化
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient and photorealistic head avatar reconstruction, yet monocular video-based or image-based methods still suffer from under-constrained geometry and texture, leading to artifacts such as blurring, stretching, and temporal instability. We present EDGAR (Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement), a conditional diffusion framework designed to enhance the quality of Gaussian avatars by correcting artifacts while preserving identity fidelity. To train EDGAR, we construct EDGAR-SET, a hybrid triplet dataset composed of real-captured and synthetic-rendered samples, which simulates realistic Gaussian avatar failure cases by pairing degraded renderings with ground-truth and reference images. EDGAR refines degraded frames through a fusion block that injects identity features extracted by the self-supervised Sapiens model into a one-step diffusion backbone, enabling effective artifact removal without sacrificing efficiency. Our EDGAR model incorporates a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture to address diverse degradation types and severity levels. The refined multi-view renderings are subsequently used as pseudo-targets to optimize a single underlying Gaussian avatar, so that the final avatar can be rendered without applying EDGAR to every output frame. Experiments on three different Gaussian avatar reconstruction methods, each evaluated under three different settings, show improvements in both perceptual and reconstruction measures over the raw outputs and an SDEdit-style refinement baseline. In addition, cross-view evaluation demonstrates improved calibrated consistency, while tests under large yaw and open-mouth expressions verify robustness under extreme settings. These results collectively indicate a useful operating regime for recoverable appearance artifacts. The code is available at https://kwanyun.github.io/edgar/
items.abstract_zh: 高斯泼溅的最新进展使得高效、照片级真实感的头部化身重建成为可能，但基于单目视频或图像的方法仍受几何和纹理约束不足之苦，导致模糊、拉伸和时间不稳定性等伪影。我们提出 EDGAR（高效扩散驱动高斯化身精化），一种条件扩散框架，旨在通过校正伪影同时保持身份保真度来提升高斯化身质量。为训练 EDGAR，我们构建 EDGAR-SET，一个由真实采集和合成渲染样本组成的混合三元组数据集，通过将退化渲染与真值图像和参考图像配对，模拟现实的高斯化身失败案例。EDGAR 通过融合模块精化退化帧，该模块将由自监督 Sapiens 模型提取的身份特征注入一步扩散主干，从而在不牺牲效率的情况下有效去除伪影。我们的 EDGAR 模型采用专家混合（MoE）架构，以应对多样的退化类型和严重程度。精化后的多视图渲染随后被用作伪目标，以优化单个底层高斯化身，使得最终化身渲染时无需对每一输出帧应用 EDGAR。在三种不同高斯化身重建方法上的实验（每种方法在三种不同设置下评估）显示，相较于原始输出和 SDEdit 风格的精化基线，在感知和重建指标上均有提升。此外，跨视图评估表明校准一致性得到改善，而大偏航角和张嘴表情下的测试验证了极端设置下的鲁棒性。这些结果共同表明，对于可恢复的外观伪影存在一个有用的工作区间。代码见 https://kwanyun.github.io/edgar/

items.title_en: Inferring viral variants and fitness advantages from longitudinal wastewater sequencing data
items.title_zh: 从纵向废水测序数据推断病毒变异株和适应度优势
items.abstract_en: During the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic, wastewater-based epidemiology emerged as an effective tool for monitoring infection dynamics. However, wastewater represents a pooled sample of incomplete viral genomic fragments originating from multiple individuals in the catchment area of a wastewater treatment plant, preventing the assembly of complete viral genomes. Existing computational pipelines are therefore limited in detecting new variants that are absent from clinical sequencing data. We developed FitNMF, an integrated viral dynamics and non-negative matrix factorization model that leverages the temporal structure of wastewater sequencing data and the underlying variant competition to jointly infer mutational signatures, relative abundances, and fitness advantages of circulating variants directly from wastewater next-generation sequencing data. Using simulated data as well as wastewater time-series data collected between 2021 and 2024 across six Swiss wastewater treatment plants, we demonstrate FitNMF's ability to identify and quantify emerging variants de novo, offering a powerful tool for real-time variant surveillance in settings with limited clinical sequencing.
items.abstract_zh: 在 SARS-CoV-2 大流行期间，基于废水的流行病学成为监测感染动态的有效工具。然而，废水是来自污水处理厂集水区多个个体的不完整病毒基因组片段的混合样本，无法组装完整病毒基因组。因此，现有计算流程在检测临床测序数据中不存在的新变异株方面受到限制。我们开发了 FitNMF，一种整合病毒动力学与非负矩阵分解的模型，利用废水测序数据的时间结构以及潜在的变异株竞争，直接从废水下一代测序数据中联合推断突变特征、相对丰度和流行变异株的适应度优势。使用模拟数据以及 2021 年至 2024 年间在瑞士六座污水处理厂采集的废水时间序列数据，我们证明 FitNMF 能够从头识别和量化新出现的变异株，为临床测序有限环境下的实时变异株监测提供有力工具。

items.title_en: Reliability of Fisher-information bounds for dielectric metalenses: a site-resolved RCWA audit
items.title_zh: 介质超透镜的 Fisher 信息界可靠性：一项位点分辨的 RCWA 审计
items.abstract_en: We assess the reliability of localization precision predicted for a 1716-nanopillar dielectric metalens using a site-resolved complex RCWA library and a vectorial Poisson Fisher model. An independent calculation reproduces the archived local axial Cramer-Rao bound of 20.7738 nm to within 0.0044 nm, yielding 20.7695 nm under the same ideal detector and 3000 detected signal photons. High-order periodic-cell calculations reveal a 0.1335 rad phase difference at a selected diameter; different substrate-index assumptions prevent attributing this difference solely to modal truncation. Replacing the recalculated coefficients at 39 actual sites changes the bound to 20.7522 nm. Restricted phase-mask benchmarks and pixel-integration checks further distinguish a stable statistical prediction from electromagnetic convergence. We provide a reproducible, model-conditional benchmark, not a physical-device performance claim.
items.abstract_zh: 我们使用位点分辨的复 RCWA 库和矢量泊松 Fisher 模型，评估针对一个由 1716 个纳米柱构成的介质超透镜所预测的定位精度的可靠性。独立计算在 0.0044 nm 以内重现了存档的局部轴向 Cramér-Rao 界 20.7738 nm，在相同理想探测器和 3000 个探测信号光子下得到 20.7695 nm。高阶周期单元计算在选定直径处揭示 0.1335 rad 的相位差；不同的衬底折射率假设使得无法将该差异仅归因于模式截断。在 39 个实际位点替换重新计算的系数后，该界变为 20.7522 nm。受限相位掩模基准和像素积分检查进一步区分了稳定的统计预测与电磁收敛。我们提供的是可复现、以模型为条件的基准，而非对物理器件性能的声明。

items.title_en: Invariance before structure: two modes of emergent compression in representation learning
items.title_zh: 结构之前的不变性：表示学习中的两种涌现压缩模式
items.abstract_en: Learned representations show striking invariance across biological and artificial neural networks, with different substrates and variations driven by drift, heterogeneity and initialisation. To understand this invariance, we propose Emergent Adaptive Representation Learning (EARL), a framework that distinguishes two modes of emergence in learned representations: state-space compression, where a learned representation gains predictive power over its own future beyond what the network's units can predict individually, and parameter-space compression, where networks with different micro-level parameters converge to the same representation. We formalise both as Fisher sensitivities and introduce ensemble-level information-theoretic measures for each. In a recurrent reservoir with a trained bottleneck, parameter-space compression rises within the first few epochs of training and partly independently of the task, whereas state-space compression rises about 30 epochs later and only when the network begins to learn the temporal structure of the task. These results suggest that invariance to the substrate and task-specific emergent structure are acquired in distinct phases of learning.
items.abstract_zh: 学习到的表示在生物和人工神经网络中表现出显著的不变性，尽管其基底不同，并存在由漂移、异质性和初始化驱动的变化。为理解这种不变性，我们提出涌现自适应表示学习（EARL）框架，区分学习表示中两种涌现模式：状态空间压缩，即学习到的表示对其自身未来获得超出网络单元单独预测能力的预测能力；以及参数空间压缩，即具有不同微观参数的网络收敛到相同表示。我们将二者形式化为 Fisher 敏感度，并为每种模式引入集成层面的信息论度量。在带有训练瓶颈的循环储备池中，参数空间压缩在训练最初几个 epoch 内上升，且部分独立于任务；而状态空间压缩约在 30 个 epoch 后上升，并且仅在网络开始学习任务的时间结构时出现。这些结果表明，对基底的不变性和任务特定的涌现结构是在学习的不同阶段获得的。

items.title_en: Enhancing Repository-Level Code Completion with Reinforcement Learning in Real-World Scenarios
items.title_zh: 在真实场景中利用强化学习增强仓库级代码补全
items.abstract_en: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) for code, which closely aligns with the practical needs of real-world software development, has sparked growing attention in repository-level code completion. However, existing Code LLMs present challenges in focusing on suitable contexts from the repository and in deeply reasoning about cross-file dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for repository-level code completion. To better understand both in-file and cross-file contexts, we employ identifier-driven intent recognition to capture completion intent, thereby improving the model's performance in real-world scenarios. To enhance cross-file reasoning, we propose a reward-driven completion learning to effectively reward in complex repository completion scenarios. To guide LLMs in completing code that aligns with intended functionality and repository context, we introduce a selective-exploration strategy that directs the model to focus on low-confidence, high-reward tokens, promoting the exploration of valuable, underexplored completion patterns. Experimental results show that our approach significantly improves the performance of Code LLMs. The code and the dataset are available at https://github.com/zhenlongDai/RepoCompletion.
items.abstract_zh: 面向代码的大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展与真实世界软件开发的实践需求紧密契合，已引发对仓库级代码补全日益增长的关注。然而，现有 Code LLM 在从仓库中聚焦合适上下文以及深入推理跨文件依赖方面仍面临挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种用于仓库级代码补全的新型强化学习框架。为更好地理解文件内和跨文件上下文，我们采用标识符驱动的意图识别来捕获补全意图，从而提升模型在真实场景中的性能。为增强跨文件推理，我们提出奖励驱动的补全学习，以在复杂仓库补全场景中有效给予奖励。为引导 LLM 补全与预期功能和仓库上下文一致的代码，我们引入选择性探索策略，引导模型关注低置信度、高奖励的 token，促进对有价值但探索不足的补全模式的探索。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著提升了 Code LLM 的性能。代码和数据集见 https://github.com/zhenlongDai/RepoCompletion。

items.title_en: Radio-to-Pose Information for Gauge-Drift Correction in Cooperative Localization
items.title_zh: 协作定位中用于规范漂移校正的无线电到位姿信息
items.abstract_en: Cooperative localization uses odometry and inter-robot measurements to estimate the motion of a robot team. These measurements describe only relative geometry, but the team's estimated position and orientation can drift together over time, i.e., gauge drift. In this work, we study correction of this gauge drift using a radio attenuation map registered in the same world coordinate frame used for robot poses. Specifically, we propose Radio-to-Pose Information (RPI), an interface that converts power residuals and their pose derivatives into a Gaussian information matrix and vector pair. RPI builds on the insight that received power is sensitive to shared displacement in the world map. The pose estimator uses the interface together with odometry and inter-robot measurements to update poses and minimize uncertainty. We characterize the shared motions detectable from the map and observed links. For an uncertain shared map, RPI keeps correlations across robots and time and reproduces joint Gaussian pose estimates and covariances. Across $1000$ simulated Gaussian trials, RPI matches the results of joint estimation. Across 32 paired trials with a registered map, RPI reduces common-position RMSE from $0.542$m to $0.140$m in a $50\times50$m arena compared with a baseline that uses radio only to weight relative measurements.
items.abstract_zh: 协作定位利用里程计和机器人间测量来估计机器人团队的运动。这些测量仅描述相对几何，但团队估计的位置和姿态可能随时间一起漂移，即规范漂移。在本工作中，我们研究利用配准到与机器人位姿相同世界坐标系中的无线电衰减图来校正这种规范漂移。具体而言，我们提出无线电到位姿信息（RPI）接口，将功率残差及其位姿导数转换为高斯信息矩阵与向量对。RPI 基于如下洞见：接收功率对世界地图中的共享位移敏感。位姿估计器将该接口与里程计和机器人间测量结合使用，以更新位姿并最小化不确定性。我们刻画了可从地图和观测链路中检测到的共享运动。对于不确定的共享地图，RPI 保持跨机器人和跨时间的相关性，并复现联合高斯位姿估计和协方差。在 1000 次模拟高斯试验中，RPI 与联合估计的结果相匹配。在带有配准地图的 32 组配对试验中，与仅使用无线电对相对测量加权的基线相比，RPI 在 50×50 m 场地中将共同位置 RMSE 从 0.542 m 降至 0.140 m。

items.title_en: A Theoretical Analysis of a Bilevel Optimization Formulation for Combined Local-Global Optical Flow Models
items.title_zh: 组合局部-全局光流模型的双层优化表述的理论分析
items.abstract_en: This paper analyzes a bilevel formulation for learning the regularization parameter of combined local-global (CLG) optical flow models. The lower-level problem computes the flow from a Lucas--Kanade data term and a quadratic or total variation (TV) regularizer, and the upper-level problem selects the parameter that minimizes the squared distance to a ground-truth flow. The setting is finite-dimensional, and a full-rank assumption makes the lower-level solution unique. For the quadratic model we derive sufficient conditions for the existence of an optimal parameter, for every optimal parameter to be positive, and for strict local optimality. For TV regularization an optimal parameter always exists, because the lower-level solution vanishes for large parameters, and we give a sufficient condition for positivity that accounts for the coupling of the two flow components through the local structure tensors. Synthetic examples illustrate the conditions, including cases in which they fail.
items.abstract_zh: 本文分析了一种用于学习组合局部-全局（CLG）光流模型正则化参数的双层表述。下层问题根据Lucas--Kanade数据项和二次或总变分（TV）正则化项计算光流，上层问题选择使与真实光流的平方距离最小化的参数。该设置是有限维的，满秩假设使下层解唯一。对于二次模型，我们推导了最优参数存在的充分条件、每个最优参数为正的充分条件以及严格局部最优性的充分条件。对于TV正则化，最优参数总是存在，因为当参数较大时下层解消失；我们给出了一个考虑两个光流分量通过局部结构张量耦合的正性充分条件。合成示例说明了这些条件，包括它们不成立的情形。

items.title_en: Identification of co-segregating RUBCN and KANK1 mutations in a UK amyotrophic lateral sclerosis kindred
items.title_zh: 在一个英国肌萎缩侧索硬化家系中鉴定共分离的RUBCN和KANK1突变
items.abstract_en: Bioinformatic analysis of next-generation sequencing data identified novel missense variants in RUBCN (p.Cys517Phe) and KANK1 (p.Pro1332Ala) that co-segregated with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in a United Kingdom kindred and were ultra-rare in European control populations (allele frequency < 0.001%). Likelihood-based segregation analysis demonstrated significant co-segregation with disease, yielding full-likelihood Bayes factor (FLB) scores of 4.6 and 5.5 for RUBCN and KANK1, respectively, exceeding the threshold supporting pathogenicity (FLB [≥] 4.33). Sex-stratified penetrance modelling identified maximal FLB scores of 7.9 for both genes under a model with male and female penetrances of 0.99 and 0.01, respectively. Gene-based burden analysis of deleterious ultra-rare variants in independent ALS case-control cohorts demonstrated exome-wide significant associations with ALS (SKAT-O, p < 1 x 10-9). Functional studies in lymphoblastoid cell lines derived from variant carriers revealed significantly increased apoptosis and dysregulated expression of genes involved in endocytosis, LC3-associated phagocytosis, endoplasmic reticulum stress, and cytoskeletal organisation (p < 0.05). Analysis of spinal cord tissue from ALS cases and controls showed significant upregulation of RUBCN (2.85-fold) and downregulation of KANK1 (0.40-fold) (p < 0.05). Collectively, these findings implicate RUBCN and KANK1 as candidate ALS genes and suggest that disruption of vesicular trafficking, autophagy-related pathways, and cytoskeletal homeostasis may contribute to disease pathogenesis of ALS.
items.abstract_zh: 对下一代测序数据的生物信息学分析鉴定了RUBCN（p.Cys517Phe）和KANK1（p.Pro1332Ala）中的新错义变异，这些变异在一个英国家系中与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）共分离，并且在欧洲对照人群中超罕见（等位基因频率 < 0.001%）。基于似然的分离分析证明与疾病显著共分离，RUBCN和KANK1的全似然贝叶斯因子（FLB）评分分别为4.6和5.5，超过支持致病性的阈值（FLB ≥ 4.33）。按性别分层的外显率建模在男性和女性外显率分别为0.99和0.01的模型下，鉴定出两个基因的最大FLB评分均为7.9。在独立ALS病例对照队列中对有害超罕见变异的基于基因的负荷分析显示与ALS存在外显子组范围显著关联（SKAT-O，p < 1×10^-9）。在来源于变异携带者的淋巴母细胞样细胞系中进行的功能研究显示凋亡显著增加，并且参与内吞作用、LC3相关吞噬作用、内质网应激和细胞骨架组织的基因表达失调（p < 0.05）。对ALS病例和对照的脊髓组织分析显示RUBCN显著上调（2.85倍）和KANK1显著下调（0.40倍）（p < 0.05）。总之，这些发现表明RUBCN和KANK1是候选ALS基因，并提示囊泡运输、自噬相关途径和细胞骨架稳态的破坏可能参与ALS的疾病发病机制。
