items.title_en: LLM-Assisted Label Noise Correction for EEG-Based Sleep Stage Classification
items.title_zh: LLM 辅助的基于 EEG 的睡眠分期分类标签噪声校正
items.abstract_en: Automatic sleep stage classification from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a critical task in clinical sleep medicine. While deep learning models have shown promising results in this domain, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the quality of training labels, which human experts manually annotate and that are subject to inter-rater disagreement and systematic labeling errors. In this paper, we propose a novel LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that operates exclusively during training to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations before retraining the classifier. Specifically, TinySleepNet is first trained on the original dataset to extract per-epoch SoftMax confidence scores, then low-confidence epochs are submitted to LLaMA 3.1 along with their EEG spectral features and surrounding sequence context. The LLM evaluates each epoch against AASM sleep-scoring guidelines and assigns a verdict of RELIABLE or SUSPICIOUS. Suspicious epochs are removed from the training set, and TinySleepNet is retrained on the cleaned data. Evaluated on the Sleep-EDF Expanded dataset using 20-fold cross-validation, our method improves overall accuracy from 81.8% to 84.6% and Macro F1-score from 75.6% to 77.4%, with particularly notable gains in REM detection. Crucially, because the LLM operates only during training, the lightweight TinySleepNet architecture (1.3M parameters) is preserved at inference, making the proposed pipeline suitable for real-time, wearable sleep monitoring applications.
items.abstract_zh: 基于脑电图（EEG）信号的自动睡眠分期分类是临床睡眠医学中的关键任务。尽管深度学习模型在该领域已显示出有前景的结果，但其性能从根本上受训练标签质量限制，这些标签由人类专家手动标注，并受到评分者间分歧和系统性标注错误的影响。本文提出一种新的 LLM 辅助标签噪声过滤流程，该流程仅在训练期间运行，在重新训练分类器之前识别并移除不可靠的睡眠分期标注。具体而言，首先在原始数据集上训练 TinySleepNet 以提取每个 epoch 的 SoftMax 置信度分数，然后将低置信度 epoch 连同其 EEG 频谱特征和周围序列上下文提交给 LLaMA 3.1。LLM 根据 AASM 睡眠评分指南评估每个 epoch，并给出 RELIABLE 或 SUSPICIOUS 的判定。可疑 epoch 从训练集中移除，并在清洗后的数据上重新训练 TinySleepNet。在 Sleep-EDF Expanded 数据集上使用 20 折交叉验证评估，我们的方法将总体准确率从 81.8% 提高到 84.6%，Macro F1 分数从 75.6% 提高到 77.4%，在 REM 检测方面提升尤其显著。关键在于，由于 LLM 仅在训练期间运行，轻量级 TinySleepNet 架构（130 万参数）在推理时得以保留，使所提流程适用于实时可穿戴睡眠监测应用。

items.title_en: H-BRICK: Hierarchical Boundary Reachability Index with Compressed Kleene Closure for Directed Grid Graphs
items.title_zh: H-BRICK：用于有向网格图的带压缩 Kleene 闭包的分层边界可达性索引
items.abstract_en: Repeated directed reachability queries arise in online path planning, task-agent allocation, and swarm control on static grid maps, where reachability is asymmetric and full transitive closure is storage-prohibitive. We introduce H-BRICK, a Hierarchical Boundary Reachability Index with Compressed Kleene closure for exact cell-to-cell queries on directed grid graphs. H-BRICK partitions the graph into tiles, computes a local Boolean Kleene closure within each tile, and projects it onto the tile's boundary ports. The resulting directed port-to-port summaries are then composed recursively across shared interfaces up to a single root covering the graph. We prove algebraically that the construction is exact: in the Boolean Kleene algebra of binary relations, every composed summary equals the boundary projection of the regional reflexive transitive closure, and every cell-to-cell query agrees with reachability in the original graph. Experiments on directed grid graphs across diverse map topologies compare H-BRICK against directed search and component-based baselines, and compare its storage requirements against full transitive closure. A batched reachability evaluation further demonstrates that sharing endpoint lifts across many-source/many-target queries amortizes hierarchical traversal and, at k=64, yields a 5.0x-22.9x throughput improvement over the scalar query loop. The results show that hierarchical boundary compression is most advantageous in query-intensive spatial graphs where online search traverses large reachable regions and the hierarchy maintains compact boundary interfaces.
items.abstract_zh: 重复的有向可达性查询出现在静态网格图上的在线路径规划、任务-智能体分配和群体控制中，其中可达性是非对称的，完整传递闭包在存储上开销过高。我们引入 H-BRICK，一种用于有向网格图上精确单元到单元查询的带压缩 Kleene 闭包的分层边界可达性索引。H-BRICK 将图划分为瓦片，在每个瓦片内计算局部布尔 Kleene 闭包，并将其投影到瓦片的边界端口上。由此得到的有向端口到端口摘要随后跨共享接口递归组合，直至覆盖整个图的单一根节点。我们从代数上证明该构造是精确的：在二元关系的布尔 Kleene 代数中，每个组合摘要都等于区域自反传递闭包的边界投影，并且每个单元到单元查询都与原图中的可达性一致。在不同地图拓扑的有向网格图上的实验将 H-BRICK 与有向搜索和基于组件的基线进行比较，并将其存储需求与完整传递闭包进行比较。批量可达性评估进一步表明，在多源/多目标查询中共享端点提升可摊销分层遍历，并且在 k=64 时相对于标量查询循环带来 5.0 倍至 22.9 倍的吞吐量提升。结果表明，分层边界压缩在查询密集型空间图中最为有利，因为在线搜索会遍历大的可达区域，而层次结构维持紧凑的边界接口。

items.title_en: Improving Long-Tail Detection via Layout-Instruction Conditioned Diffusion Synthesis
items.title_zh: 通过布局指令条件化扩散合成提升长尾检测
items.abstract_en: Synthetic data from diffusion models can improve object detection, but long-tail performance is still limited by scarce rare classes and inflexible conditioning (e.g., text-only or layout-only inputs). In this paper, we propose Tail-SD, a layout-instruction conditioned stable diffusion framework that supports text, layouts, or their hybrid, enabling controllable synthesis from boxes, masks, and/or prompts to better cover the long-tail objects. To train a single model across heterogeneous conditions, we introduce a multi-task cross-attention module and multi-task embedding tokens, improving generation quality and diversity. Extensive experiments on COCO and LVIS demonstrate that diffusion synthesis with hybrid conditioning consistently benefits detection, e.g., on LVIS val, it achieves +4.89% / +5.68% rare Box/Mask AP, highlighting strong potential for addressing long-tail challenges.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散模型生成的合成数据可以改进目标检测，但长尾性能仍受限于稀有类别稀少和条件化不灵活（例如仅文本或仅布局输入）。本文提出 Tail-SD，一种布局指令条件化的稳定扩散框架，支持文本、布局或二者混合，从而能够从框、掩码和/或提示进行可控合成，以更好地覆盖长尾目标。为在异构条件下训练单一模型，我们引入多任务交叉注意力模块和多任务嵌入 token，提升生成质量和多样性。在 COCO 和 LVIS 上的大量实验表明，采用混合条件化的扩散合成持续有利于检测，例如在 LVIS val 上，稀有类 Box/Mask AP 分别提升 +4.89% / +5.68%，凸显其应对长尾挑战的强大潜力。

items.title_en: Discrete Backbone Elasticity and Curvature-Dependent Torsion Statistics in Proteins
items.title_zh: 蛋白质中的离散主链弹性与曲率依赖的扭转统计
items.abstract_en: Coarse-grained models of protein conformational dynamics use $\mathrm{C}_α$ geometry to describe the probabilities of regular helices, ordered turns and disordered conformations. To test how much of this order arises from local chain elasticity, we connect discrete Hasimoto frame transport to neighboring bending mismatch, deriving a curvature-product torsion interaction and a six-parameter generalized von Mises density. Fitted on 194 chains from the ATLAS molecular dynamics database and tested on 1744 sequence-nonredundant proteins, this baseline reduces negative log-density loss from 1.490 to 1.160 nats, torsion-sign error from 12.26 to 2.15 percentage points, and helix-fraction error from 21.84 to 10.41 points. Ablations and circular-moment projections against reference generative models motivate extensions to anisotropic stiffness and two partition-function-weighted elastic states, further lowering test loss to 0.790 nats and helix error to 1.65 points. The fixed hierarchy also improves predictions across 72 trajectories of peptides $\mathrm{Fs}$ and $(\mathrm{AAQAA})_3$ and miniprotein $\mathrm{HP35}$ spanning varied starting conformations and force fields. Remaining angular errors in these trajectories are associated with atomic context at shared bends, as bend-matched peptide frames adopt opposite torsion signs with distinct hydrogen-bond patterns and a proline-containing $\mathrm{HP35}$ turn remains at negative torsion. Introducing a bilinearly coupled $\mathrm{C}_α$--$\mathrm{N}$ orientation angle largely reparameterizes the existing bend-dependent harmonics, with an empirical $L^2$ Gram projection placing 96.7\% to 99.6\% of its added coefficient-function squared norm within the original six-function span. These results link discrete Hasimoto elasticity to statistical backbone potentials and clarify the scope and limits of local $\mathrm{C}_α$ geometry.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质构象动力学的粗粒化模型使用 Cα 几何来描述规则螺旋、有序转角和无序构象的概率。为检验这种有序性中有多少来自局部链弹性，我们将离散 Hasimoto 标架传输与相邻弯曲失配联系起来，推导出曲率乘积扭转相互作用和一个六参数广义 von Mises 密度。在来自 ATLAS 分子动力学数据库的 194 条链上拟合，并在 1744 个序列非冗余蛋白质上测试，该基线将负对数密度损失从 1.490 nats 降至 1.160 nats，将扭转符号误差从 12.26 个百分点降至 2.15 个百分点，将螺旋比例误差从 21.84 个百分点降至 10.41 个百分点。消融实验以及与参考生成模型对比的圆矩投影，促使扩展至各向异性刚度和两个配分函数加权的弹性状态，进一步将测试损失降至 0.790 nats，并将螺旋误差降至 1.65 个百分点。该固定层级结构还改善了在肽 Fs 与 (AAQAA)3 及微型蛋白 HP35 的 72 条轨迹上的预测，这些轨迹跨越不同的起始构象和力场。这些轨迹中剩余的角误差与共享弯曲处的原子环境有关，因为弯曲匹配的肽帧采用相反的扭转符号并具有不同的氢键模式，而含脯氨酸的 HP35 转角仍处于负扭转。引入双线性耦合的 Cα–N 取向角在很大程度上重新参数化了现有的弯曲依赖谐波，经验 L2 Gram 投影将其新增系数函数平方范数的 96.7% 至 99.6% 置于原始六函数张成空间内。这些结果将离散 Hasimoto 弹性与统计主链势联系起来，并阐明了局部 Cα 几何的范围和局限。

items.title_en: Beyond Quantum Messages: Toward Quantum-Native Network Functioning
items.title_zh: 超越量子消息：迈向量子原生网络功能
items.abstract_en: The Quantum Internet is commonly envisioned as a network that transports quantum states and distributes entanglement as the key resource underpinning distributed quantum applications. This view is necessary but incomplete if quantum phenomena are confined to what the network carries or manages, while network functionalities remain grounded predominantly in classical abstractions. This Perspective advances a broader thesis: quantum phenomena can also participate directly in the realization of network functionalities. We first establish the architectural baseline by introducing entanglement as a stateful network resource whose operational condition is non-locally distributed across remote nodes, evolves through manipulation or consumption, and degrades over time through decoherence. Its evolving state must therefore remain visible to the functionalities acting on it. We then move beyond resource visibility and use two mechanisms as proof points of a broader quantum-native functional design space: entanglement generation during propagation through coherent spatial-path superposition, and operational connectivity induced by shared entanglement that can depart from the physical graph. These examples show that paths, neighbors, or participating nodes may become operationally relevant in ways determined by quantum coherence and shared entanglement, rather than by physical connectivity alone. We identify Quantum Addressing as a transversal abstraction capable of representing such relations while complementing, rather than replacing, classical addressing and signaling. The resulting perspective broadens the Quantum Internet from transporting quantum information and distributing entanglement to exploiting quantum phenomena in network functioning, opening a coupled frontier spanning routing, forwarding, control, and functionality placement.
items.abstract_zh: 量子互联网通常被设想为传输量子态并分发纠缠的网络，纠缠是支撑分布式量子应用的关键资源。如果量子现象仅限于网络所承载或管理的内容，而网络功能仍主要基于经典抽象，那么这种观点虽必要但不完整。本观点文章提出一个更广泛的论点：量子现象也可以直接参与网络功能的实现。我们首先建立架构基线，将纠缠引入为一种有状态网络资源，其运行条件非局部地分布在远程节点上，通过操纵或消耗而演化，并因退相干随时间退化。因此，其演化状态必须对作用于其上的功能保持可见。随后，我们超越资源可见性，以两个机制作为更广泛量子原生功能设计空间的例证：通过相干空间路径叠加在传播过程中生成纠缠，以及由共享纠缠诱导的、可偏离物理图的操作连通性。这些例子表明，路径、邻居或参与节点可能以由量子相干和共享纠缠而非仅物理连通性决定的方式变得在操作上相关。我们将量子寻址识别为一种横向抽象，能够表示此类关系，同时补充而非替代经典寻址与信令。由此形成的观点将量子互联网从传输量子信息和分发纠缠，拓展到在网络功能中利用量子现象，开辟了跨越路由、转发、控制和功能放置的耦合前沿。

items.title_en: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
items.title_zh: 静态恢复并非动态稳定性：蛋白质基序支架设计的动力学感知基准评测
items.abstract_en: Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. We further introduce BILBY-MD, a reference-based all-atom molecular dynamics evaluation framework. Applied to statically solved designs from the original MotifBench benchmark, it compares motif drift, scaffold drift, motif-contact preservation, and motif-dihedral free-energy landscapes against reference simulations. Of 55 statically solved model-problem pairs, 31 satisfy our MD-supported criterion and only 8 pass all checks. Compact, self-contained motifs are often MD-supported, whereas interface-like or context-dependent motifs fail more frequently. Static refolding success therefore provides useful evidence of local motif recovery but does not establish dynamical fidelity of the full scaffold. BILBY highlights three complementary axes of motif-scaffolding evaluation: target coverage, unique-solution yield, and MD-supported dynamical fidelity.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质基序支架设计基准评估生成模型能否围绕功能重要残基构建支架。其结论取决于测试哪些基序以及哪些标准定义成功。现有基准通常使用小型手工整理的基序集和静态重折叠标准，但蛋白质功能常常依赖构象集合和转变。本文同时处理基准范围和成功标准。我们引入 BILBY-PRO，一个从 PROSITE 关联实验结构中系统衍生的结构保守功能基序基准，包含来自 174 个 PROSITE 基序模式条目的 220 个案例。评估六个近期支架生成模型，揭示了在目标覆盖和唯一解产出方面的不同模式：RFDiffusion 和 Proteina 求解更多目标，而 ESM3 在其求解的目标上产生更多唯一成功支架。我们进一步引入 BILBY-MD，一个基于参考的全原子分子动力学评估框架。将其应用于原始 MotifBench 基准中静态求解的设计，它将基序漂移、支架漂移、基序接触保持和基序二面角自由能景观与参考模拟进行比较。在 55 个静态求解的模型—问题对中，31 个满足我们的 MD 支持标准，仅 8 个通过所有检查。紧凑、自包含的基序通常获得 MD 支持，而类界面或依赖上下文的基序更频繁失败。因此，静态重折叠成功为局部基序恢复提供了有用证据，但并不能确立完整支架的动力学保真度。BILBY 突出了基序支架评估的三个互补轴：目标覆盖、唯一解产出和 MD 支持的动力学保真度。

items.title_en: AraEngage: Interpretable Linguistic Correlates of Engagement in Arabic Facebook News
items.title_zh: AraEngage：阿拉伯语 Facebook 新闻中互动度的可解释语言相关因素
items.abstract_en: Engagement features developed for English are routinely applied to Arabic, but unvocalized Arabic changes what a lexical feature measures. We introduce AraEngage, a query-defined sample of 10,000 public Arabic Facebook news posts from 2,451 pages in 57 countries (2023-2024) that pairs engagement counts with interpretable linguistic features. We use it to examine which interpretable Arabic indicators are associated with follower-normalized engagement, and how far those associations can be trusted given publisher context, the definition of engagement, and lexical ambiguity. Religious expressions, message length, sentence length, and lexical density are the leading correlates in a Random Forest model ($R^2$ = 0.38 on a post-level split) interpreted with SHAP. Unlike English news, positive sentiment is associated with higher engagement in this Arabic news sample. Message length shows a length paradox: unadjusted raw engagement is highest for long posts, whereas the model's attributions for follower-normalized engagement favor short posts. A linguistic audit identifies why standard lexicon features are fragile in unvocalized Arabic: imperative lists contain homographs such as the form read as "express!" that is also the frequent preposition "via", hedge lists conflate the possibility marker qad + imperfect ("may") with the emphatic qad + perfect ("has indeed"), and religious lists mix devotional formulas with place names in political news. These are plausible sources of measurement error that may attenuate the near-zero associations of imperatives and hedges. All findings are observational associations with operationalized indicators. We release the derived linguistic features, engagement counts, refined lexicons, and analysis code; raw posts are not redistributed, in line with CrowdTangle terms.
items.abstract_zh: 为英语开发的互动度特征常被直接应用于阿拉伯语，但未标音阿拉伯语会改变词汇特征所度量的内容。我们引入 AraEngage，一个查询定义的样本，包含来自 57 个国家 2451 个页面的 10000 条公开阿拉伯语 Facebook 新闻帖子（2023—2024 年），将互动计数与可解释语言特征配对。我们用它考察哪些可解释阿拉伯语指标与粉丝归一化互动度相关，以及在发布者背景、互动度定义和词汇歧义下这些关联的可信程度。在采用 SHAP 解释的随机森林模型中（帖子级划分上 R^2=0.38），宗教表达、消息长度、句子长度和词汇密度是主要相关因素。与英语新闻不同，在该阿拉伯语新闻样本中，积极情感与更高互动度相关。消息长度呈现长度悖论：未调整的原始互动量在长帖子中最高，而模型对粉丝归一化互动量的归因更偏向短帖子。语言审计识别出标准词表特征在未标音阿拉伯语中为何脆弱：祈使词表包含同形异义词，例如读作“express!”的形式同时也是高频介词“via”；模糊限制词表将可能性标记 qad + 未完成体（“may”）与强调性 qad + 完成体（“has indeed”）混为一谈；宗教词表将虔敬套语与政治新闻中的地名混在一起。这些是可能的测量误差来源，可能削弱祈使句和模糊限制语接近零的关联。所有发现均为与操作化指标之间的观察性关联。我们发布衍生语言特征、互动计数、精炼词表和分析代码；原始帖子不再分发，以符合 CrowdTangle 条款。

items.title_en: Reinforcing End-to-End Autonomous Driving Safety via Negative-Aware Planning in a Unified World-Action Model
items.title_zh: 在统一世界-动作模型中通过负样本感知规划增强端到端自动驾驶安全
items.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) jointly model future traffic states and driving actions for end-to-end autonomous driving in intelligent transportation systems. However, their action learning remains dominated by expert-trajectory imitation, leaving unsafe alternatives close to expert trajectories insufficiently constrained. To improve WAM robustness in safety-critical scenarios, we propose NegWAM, a safety post-training framework for unified WAMs that learns explicit safety boundaries from near-expert failure trajectories. NegWAM constructs negative trajectories that are geometrically close to the expert trajectory yet carry safety risks, uses them as repulsive anchors to steer predictions away from dangerous behavior, and encodes them as scene-conditioned rider tokens to learn scene--trajectory compatibility. During training, NegWAM jointly optimizes the flow-matching and near-expert negative objectives, while the auxiliary rider branch is discarded at inference, incurring no additional overhead. On NAVSIM v2, NegWAM achieves 40.4 EPDMS on navhard, a 4.1% relative improvement over the strongest compared scorer-free WAM baseline, and achieves 93.3 EPDMS on navtest. These results demonstrate that NegWAM achieves strong performance in safety-critical scenarios while preserving routine-driving performance. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM further demonstrates cross-benchmark generalization. The code is available at https://github.com/Zizizi-hao/NegWAM.
items.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAM）联合建模未来交通状态和驾驶动作，用于智能交通系统中的端到端自动驾驶。然而，其动作学习仍由专家轨迹模仿主导，导致接近专家轨迹的不安全替代方案未得到充分约束。为提升 WAM 在安全关键场景中的鲁棒性，我们提出 NegWAM，一种用于统一 WAM 的安全后训练框架，从接近专家的失败轨迹中学习显式安全边界。NegWAM 构建在几何上接近专家轨迹但带有安全风险的负轨迹，将其用作排斥锚点以引导预测远离危险行为，并将其编码为场景条件化的 rider token，以学习场景—轨迹兼容性。训练期间，NegWAM 联合优化流匹配和接近专家的负样本目标，而辅助 rider 分支在推理时被丢弃，不产生额外开销。在 NAVSIM v2 上，NegWAM 在 navhard 上达到 40.4 EPDMS，相较最强的对比无评分器 WAM 基线相对提升 4.1%，并在 navtest 上达到 93.3 EPDMS。这些结果表明，NegWAM 在安全关键场景中取得强劲性能，同时保持常规驾驶性能。在 HUGSIM 上的零样本闭环评估进一步展示了跨基准泛化能力。代码见 https://github.com/Zizizi-hao/NegWAM。

items.title_en: DC-SQEM: Medial Mesh Extraction by Dual Contouring with Spherical Quadric Error Metric
items.title_zh: DC-SQEM：利用球面二次误差度量的对偶轮廓法中轴网格提取
items.abstract_en: The medial axis, as a compact representation, describes not only the boundary but also the interior of the shape, and has been widely used in analyzing and simplifying shapes. However, approximating feature-preserving medial axis from unstructured data, such as oriented point clouds, remains challenging due to the lack of explicit connectivity and the presence of noise in the source. We propose DC-SQEM, a dual-contouring-based framework that computes medial meshes (an explicit representation of the medial axis) directly from oriented point clouds without relying on watertight manifold surfaces or volumetric structures. With the help of an adaptive octree, our method fits local medial spheres for each cell based on the Spherical Quadric Error Metric (SQEM). We address several long-standing robustness issues in dual-contouring and mesh extraction, including out-of-cell solutions, unstable feature classification, and redundant topological connections. To this end, we introduce virtual nodes, a feature-downgrading strategy, and a geometry-driven topology-aware cleanup procedure, enabling robust SQEM-based medial dual contouring with clean mesh outputs. Unlike prior point-cloud-based methods that produce either only 1D skeletal structures or incomplete medial features, our method preserves sharp geometric features from the input and reconstructs a complete medial structure, including sheets, curves, seams, and junctions. Compared to restricted-power-diagram-based approaches, our algorithm can handle point clouds as input, without having a strong requirement on water-tightness or manifoldness.
items.abstract_zh: 中轴作为一种紧凑表示，不仅描述形状的边界，还描述形状的内部，已被广泛用于分析和简化形状。然而，从无结构数据（如有向点云）中近似保持特征的中轴仍具有挑战性，原因是源数据缺乏显式连通性且存在噪声。我们提出 DC-SQEM，一种基于对偶轮廓法的框架，可直接从有向点云计算中轴网格（中轴的显式表示），而不依赖于水密流形表面或体结构。借助自适应八叉树，我们的方法基于球面二次误差度量（SQEM）为每个单元拟合局部中轴球。我们解决了对偶轮廓法和网格提取中若干长期存在的鲁棒性问题，包括单元外解、不稳定的特征分类以及冗余的拓扑连接。为此，我们引入虚拟节点、特征降级策略以及几何驱动的拓扑感知清理过程，从而实现基于 SQEM 的鲁棒中轴对称轮廓法并输出干净网格。与先前基于点云的方法仅生成一维骨架结构或不完整中轴特征不同，我们的方法保留输入的锐利几何特征，并重建完整的中轴结构，包括片、曲线、接缝和交汇点。与基于受限幂图的方法相比，我们的算法可以处理点云输入，而不对水密性或流形性有强要求。

items.title_en: A Bayesian Optimized Biquad Filter-Burg Model for Real-Time EEG Phase Estimation
items.title_zh: 一种用于实时 EEG 相位估计的贝叶斯优化双二阶滤波器-Burg 模型
items.abstract_en: Real-time phase estimation on stimulus-aligned transient EEG is critical for closed-loop neuromodulation systems targeting the theta-band, yet most real-time phase estimation methods have been developed and validated on resting-state, high-fidelity signals in the alpha band. Recent work has pursued deep learning architectures, while individualized classical bandpass filter tuning remains underexplored. This study characterizes the spectral and temporal properties of non-anticipative bandpass filtering and demonstrates the performance gains achieved through individualized tuning. We present a Bayesian-Optimized Biquad Filter-Burg (BOB) model evaluated on EEG recorded during peripheral vibrotactile stimulation of the left median nerve (theta, N=20 healthy subjects) and on resting-state recordings from the Max Planck Institute's LEMON dataset (alpha, N=20 healthy subjects). BOB was benchmarked against the Deep Dual-Branch Complex Neural Network (DBCNN), EEG Phase Prediction Network (EPN), Phastimate, and Phase Estimation with Autoregressive Padding (PEAP) under matched testing conditions: channel selection, individualized optimization, evaluation time points, and an offline reference phase obtained through zero-phase filtering and the Hilbert transform. Under these testing conditions, BOB achieved matched or better performance than these models at a fraction of the calibration time.
items.abstract_zh: 对与刺激对齐的瞬态 EEG 进行实时相位估计，对于面向 theta 频段的闭环神经调控系统至关重要，但大多数实时相位估计方法是在 alpha 频段的静息态、高保真信号上开发和验证的。近期工作探索了深度学习架构，而个体化的经典带通滤波器调参仍未得到充分研究。本研究刻画了非预期（non-anticipative）带通滤波的频谱和时间特性，并证明了通过个体化调参获得的性能提升。我们提出一种贝叶斯优化双二阶滤波器-Burg（BOB）模型，并在左侧正中神经外周振动触觉刺激期间记录的 EEG（theta，N=20 名健康受试者）以及马克斯·普朗克研究所 LEMON 数据集的静息态记录（alpha，N=20 名健康受试者）上进行评估。在匹配的测试条件下——通道选择、个体化优化、评估时间点，以及通过零相位滤波和希尔伯特变换获得的离线参考相位——将 BOB 与深度双分支复数神经网络（DBCNN）、EEG 相位预测网络（EPN）、Phastimate 和带自回归填充的相位估计（PEAP）进行基准比较。在这些测试条件下，BOB 以一小部分校准时间达到了与这些模型相当或更好的性能。

items.title_en: Persistent level-resolved transmon population after dispersive readout, and the limits of its open-system description
items.title_zh: 色散读出后持续存在的能级分辨 transmon 布居及其开放系统描述的局限性
items.abstract_en: We calculate the level-resolved transmon population remaining after dispersive readout with a converged open-system model. The drive and qubit-cavity coupling use the rotating-wave approximation, while the cavity is a quantized mode in a frame displaced by its classical trajectory. At a readout occupation of 80, the model leaves a persistent distribution across the first transmon levels, with p2 = 1.02 x 10^-3 and p3 = 4.10 x 10^-5 at the end of readout. These populations survive an additional drive-off wait: over 73 ns each level decays by less than 3 percent and follows its own relaxation rate, not the near-factor-of-two drop in residual cavity photons. This identifies the population as bare-level occupation rather than coherent dressing. Channel-removal and bath-model controls attribute p2 mainly to dephasing and p3 and above mainly to relaxation, unchanged across bath models though absolute values vary by up to 15 percent. We also test the coherent drive truncation. In dissipation-free transmon-only benchmarks driven by the classical cavity trajectory, the nearest-neighbour RWA drive underestimates the full charge-operator result while the drive is on. At switch-off for occupation 80, where coherent populations are hundreds of times larger than the residual values, p2(RWA)/p2(full) = 0.905 and p3(RWA)/p3(full) = 0.759, with larger discrepancies at deeper levels. One source is a parity-allowed non-nearest-neighbour charge matrix element omitted by the drive operator. A naive beyond-RWA extension with bare-basis Lindblad dissipators fails a zero-drive ground-state test and serves only as a diagnostic. A dressed-basis (secular) construction instead leaves the dressed ground state stationary at zero drive. The result is a converged RWA prediction of readout-induced population plus direct tests of where the approximation loses quantitative reliability.
items.abstract_zh: 我们用一个收敛的开放系统模型计算了色散读出后剩余的能级分辨 transmon 布居。驱动和量子比特-腔耦合采用旋转波近似，而腔是在由其经典轨迹位移的参考系中的量子化模式。在读出占据数为 80 时，该模型在最初的 transmon 能级上留下持续分布，读出结束时 p2 = 1.02 x 10^-3、p3 = 4.10 x 10^-5。这些布居在额外的关断驱动等待后仍然存在：在 73 ns 内，每个能级的衰减小于 3%，并遵循各自的弛豫速率，而不是残余腔光子接近减半的下降。这将该布居识别为裸能级占据，而非相干缀饰。通道移除和浴模型对照将 p2 主要归因于退相位，将 p3 及以上主要归因于弛豫；尽管绝对值最多变化 15%，这些归因在不同浴模型间不变。我们还测试了相干驱动截断。在由经典腔轨迹驱动的无耗散仅 transmon 基准中，驱动开启时最近邻 RWA 驱动低估了完整电荷算符结果。在占据数为 80 的关断时刻，相干布居比残余值大数百倍，p2(RWA)/p2(full) = 0.905，p3(RWA)/p3(full) = 0.759，且在更深能级处差异更大。一个来源是驱动算符省略了宇称允许的非最近邻电荷矩阵元。采用裸基 Lindblad 耗散器的朴素超越 RWA 扩展未通过零驱动基态测试，仅能作为诊断。相反，缀饰基（久期）构造使缀饰基态在零驱动下保持静止。结果是一个收敛的 RWA 预测的读出诱导布居，以及对近似在何处失去定量可靠性的直接检验。

items.title_en: Vertical Segmented Waveguide-Enabled Pinching Antenna (V-SWAN)-Assisted EDMA-NOMA Integrated Sensing and Communication Systems
items.title_zh: 垂直分段波导赋能的夹持天线（V-SWAN）辅助 EDMA-NOMA 集成感知与通信系统
items.abstract_en: This paper proposes a vertical segmented waveguide-enabled pinching antenna (V-SWAN)-assisted downlink non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) environmental division multiple access (EDMA) framework for simultaneously supporting multi-user communication and target sensing. In the proposed framework, multiple pinching antennas (PAs) are deployed along a segmented vertical dielectric waveguide to serve communication users (CUs), aerial users (AUs), and sensing target (ST). CUs are distributed on the ground, whereas AUs and ST are above the ground, where line-of-sight (LoS) and non-line-of-sight (NLoS) propagation conditions coexist. In particular, SWAN provides an effective platform for realizing EDMA by reducing the effective propagation distance and in-waveguide attenuation, thereby suppressing co-channel interference and enabling efficient multi-user transmission. The communication and sensing model are formulated, followed by the corresponding SINR expressions. We formulate the statistical characterizations for the combination of LoS and NLoS propagation for CUs, and LoS propagation for AUs and sensing channels for generalized multi-user, multi-PA scenarios. Based on these statistical characterizations, the segment outage and sensing outage probabilities are derived and evaluated for the generalized framework. The asymptotic evaluation is also done at a high transmit signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to gain further insights. The results show that the proposed framework outperforms the conventional H-SWAN and single vertical pinching antenna system (V-PASS) in terms of segment outage probability, sensing outage probability, and segment sum rate. Monte Carlo simulation results closely match the analytical results, validating the accuracy of the derived expressions.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种垂直分段波导赋能的夹持天线（V-SWAN）辅助下行非正交多址接入（NOMA）集成感知与通信（ISAC）环境分多址（EDMA）框架，用于同时支持多用户通信和目标感知。在所提框架中，多个夹持天线（PA）沿分段垂直介质波导部署，以服务通信用户（CU）、空中用户（AU）和感知目标（ST）。CU 分布在地面，而 AU 和 ST 位于地面以上，其中视距（LoS）和非视距（NLoS）传播条件共存。特别地，SWAN 通过降低有效传播距离和波导内衰减，为抑制同信道干扰并实现高效多用户传输提供了一种实现 EDMA 的有效平台。文中建立了通信和感知模型，随后给出相应的 SINR 表达式。我们针对广义多用户、多 PA 场景，建立了 CU 的 LoS 与 NLoS 传播组合、AU 的 LoS 传播以及感知信道的统计表征。基于这些统计表征，推导并评估了广义框架下的分段中断概率和感知中断概率。还在高发射信噪比（SNR）下进行渐近评估以获得进一步洞见。结果表明，所提框架在分段中断概率、感知中断概率和分段和速率方面优于传统 H-SWAN 和单垂直夹持天线系统（V-PASS）。蒙特卡洛仿真结果与分析结果高度吻合，验证了推导表达式的准确性。

items.title_en: Evaluating Token Probabilities as Confidence Estimators in Human Behavior Simulations: A Case Study in Luxembourgish Next Like Prediction
items.title_zh: 评估 token 概率作为人类行为模拟中的置信度估计器：以卢森堡语下一点赞预测为例
items.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior, their operational validity is typically assessed through accuracy alone, implicitly treating human behavior as deterministic. We argue that on noisy digital trace data, a model's performance depends not only on predicting the correct outcome but on its calibration. We present a case study testing whether the token probabilities of open-weight LLMs can serve as confidence estimates in a Next Like Prediction task: predicting how a user of the Luxembourgish news platform RTL.lu rates a comment, conditioned on their prior interactions. Evaluating Ministral 3 (3B, 8B), we find that, with in-context learning only, the tested models are overconfident and are outperformed on accuracy and calibration by a simple statistical baseline. Accuracy and calibration do not move together: scaling from 3B to 8B improves accuracy while degrading calibration, and longer behavioral histories raise accuracy while confidence declines. Task-specific supervised fine-tuning acts as an effective calibration intervention, reducing Expected Calibration Error from 0.2 to 0.006 while improving accuracy from 0.536 to 0.758. We conclude that confidence estimation should be evaluated alongside accuracy to improve validity when using LLM-based agents.
items.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于模拟人类行为，其操作有效性通常仅通过准确率来评估，这隐含地将人类行为视为确定性的。我们认为，在含噪数字痕迹数据上，模型性能不仅取决于预测正确结果，还取决于其校准。我们提出一个案例研究，检验开放权重 LLM 的 token 概率能否在“下一点赞预测”任务中作为置信度估计：在给定用户先前交互的条件下，预测卢森堡语新闻平台 RTL.lu 的用户如何评价一条评论。评估 Ministral 3（3B、8B）后，我们发现，仅使用上下文学习时，所测试模型过度自信，并在准确率和校准上均被一个简单统计基线超越。准确率和校准并不同步变化：从 3B 扩展到 8B 提高了准确率但降低了校准，更长的行为历史提高了准确率但置信度下降。任务特定的监督微调是一种有效的校准干预，将期望校准误差从 0.2 降至 0.006，同时将准确率从 0.536 提升至 0.758。我们得出结论：在使用基于 LLM 的智能体时，应将置信度估计与准确率一起评估，以提高有效性。

items.title_en: Dual-Arm Tabletop Rearrangement with Movable Stacking and Gap-Aware Push Transfers
items.title_zh: 基于可移动堆叠与间隙感知推动转移的双臂桌面重排
items.abstract_en: Object rearrangement in cluttered tabletop scenes is challenging, especially in wide workspaces where dual-arm systems improve coverage and efficiency. Limited free space often necessitates buffering, while objects near or across the shared reachability region of the manipulators must be transferred under careful coordination to avoid inter-arm collisions. Conventional inter-arm transfer typically relies on a fixed handoff configuration, which constrains where and how objects are exchanged, enforces spatiotemporal synchronization of the arms, and reduces flexibility in dense layouts. This paper presents a dual-arm rearrangement framework that combines movable stacking with Gap-Aware Push Transfer for asynchronous cross-boundary exchange. The method scans the shared boundary to identify collision-free transfer gaps, places an object near a selected crossing point, and then pushes it into the receiving workspace without requiring simultaneous interaction between the two arms. A joint Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based planner coordinates both manipulators while reasoning over buffering and transfer decisions, and execution cost is used after planning to assess the resulting plan. Experiments show that the proposed method shortens joint execution sequences and becomes increasingly advantageous over a fixed handoff baseline as scene density increases, achieving lower execution cost in denser scenes while remaining competitive in lighter ones.
items.abstract_zh: 在杂乱桌面场景中进行物体重排具有挑战性，尤其是在双臂系统可提高覆盖范围和效率的宽工作空间中。有限的自由空间通常需要缓冲，而位于或跨越机械臂共享可达区域附近的物体必须在仔细协调下转移，以避免臂间碰撞。传统的臂间转移通常依赖固定的交接配置，这限制了物体交换的位置和方式，强制双臂在时空上同步，并降低了密集布局中的灵活性。本文提出一种双臂重排框架，将可移动堆叠与间隙感知推动转移相结合，用于异步跨边界交换。该方法扫描共享边界以识别无碰撞转移间隙，将物体放置在选定穿越点附近，然后将其推入接收工作空间，而不需要两臂同时交互。一个联合的基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的规划器在推理缓冲和转移决策的同时协调两个机械臂，并在规划后使用执行成本评估所得计划。实验表明，所提方法缩短了联合执行序列，并且随着场景密度增加，相对于固定交接基线越来越具有优势，在更密集场景中实现更低执行成本，同时在较稀疏场景中仍具竞争力。

items.title_en: TraCE: Trajectory-Aware Concepts for Explainable Video Understanding
items.title_zh: TraCE：面向可解释视频理解的轨迹感知概念
items.abstract_en: Video understanding models often rely on motion, yet their explanations can obscure which motion sources support a prediction. We identify motion-source under-specification as a limitation of existing video XAI: region-centric explanations can be source-ambiguous, while motion vocabularies restricted to single-person pose sequences are source-incomplete. We propose TraCE (Trajectory-Aware Concepts for Explainable Video Understanding), a concept-based framework that discovers source-flexible motion concepts by clustering optical-flow trajectories from training videos. These concepts represent dynamic evidence from people, objects, and interactions, while object and scene concepts account for static context. The resulting typed trajectory/object/scene interface supports class prediction for action recognition and question-conditioned concept matching for video question answering (VQA). We evaluate TraCE across five random seeds on six benchmarks: NTU RGB+D Mutual, Chiral SSv2, UCF-101, KTH, TOMATO, and STAR. Relative to non-interpretable baselines, TraCE maintains competitive task performance, with an average accuracy drop of 1.0 points for action recognition and a nominal gain of 0.4 points for VQA. Motion perturbation and concept-removal tests provide complementary evidence of directional semantic alignment and decision faithfulness, while sample-level interventions illustrate targeted model debugging. Our project page is available at https://leewooil.github.io/TraCE_project_page/.
items.abstract_zh: 视频理解模型通常依赖运动，但其解释可能会掩盖哪些运动来源支持预测。我们将运动来源描述不足识别为现有视频XAI的一个局限：以区域为中心的解释可能存在来源歧义，而局限于单人姿态序列的运动词汇表则在来源上不完整。我们提出TraCE（面向可解释视频理解的轨迹感知概念），一个基于概念的框架，通过聚类训练视频中的光流轨迹来发现来源灵活的运动概念。这些概念表示来自人、物体和交互的动态证据，而物体和场景概念则考虑静态上下文。由此产生的类型化轨迹/物体/场景接口支持动作识别的类别预测和视频问答（VQA）中问题条件下的概念匹配。我们在六个基准上以五个随机种子评估TraCE：NTU RGB+D Mutual、Chiral SSv2、UCF-101、KTH、TOMATO和STAR。相对于不可解释基线，TraCE保持了有竞争力的任务性能，动作识别平均准确率下降1.0个百分点，VQA名义提升0.4个百分点。运动扰动和概念移除测试提供了方向性语义对齐和决策忠实度的补充证据，而样本级干预则展示了有针对性的模型调试。我们的项目页面见 https://leewooil.github.io/TraCE_project_page/。

items.title_en: Computational Modeling of the Acoustic Radiation Force and Viscoelastic Displacement for Transcranial Focused Ultrasound Neuromodulation
items.title_zh: 经颅聚焦超声神经调控中声辐射力与粘弹性位移的计算建模
items.abstract_en: Objective: In transcranial ultrasound neuromodulation (TUS), simulations of the harmonic pressure are often used for treatment planning. However, other mechanisms of energy transfer, such as acoustic radiation force (ARF) and the resulting tissue displacement, are reported less frequently. Furthermore, there is limited guidance on how these mechanisms should be simulated. This study evaluates the numerical convergence and accuracy of different ARF formulations and investigates the simulation of ultrasound-induced tissue displacement in the context of TUS. Approach: Two simulations steps are used in k-Wave to first simulate the first order acoustic pressure and velocity fields. Subsequently, these fields are used to calculate the ARF using the momentum-flux density tensor, Reynolds stress force, and attenuation force formulations. The ARF is then applied as input for a second viscoelastic simulation to estimate the tissue displacement induced by the ultrasound field. Numerical accuracy and convergence are quantified as functions of the various numerical choices and hyperparameters in the solvers. Main results: Among the investigated formulations, the attenuation-force approach proved to be the most robust and the least susceptible to numerical errors across variable medium types and transducer geometries. Within the parameter space relevant to TUS, it is a valid approximation of the momentum flux density tensor formulation. Similar tissue displacement distributions are found across the different ARF formulations. However, the accuracy of the displacement simulation decreases with increasing pulse duration. Finally, recommendations are formulated on the ARF calculation method and on the numerical hyperparameters for ARF and displacement simulations. Significance: This study offers guidelines for calculating the ARF and simulating tissue displacement. The proposed framework enables a more comprehensive characterization of ultrasound-mediated energy transfer in TUS.
items.abstract_zh: 目的：在经颅超声神经调控（TUS）中，谐波压力的仿真常用于治疗规划。然而，其他能量传递机制，如声辐射力（ARF）及由此产生的组织位移，报道较少。此外，关于这些机制应如何仿真，现有指导有限。本研究评估不同ARF表达式的数值收敛性和准确性，并研究TUS背景下超声诱导组织位移的仿真。方法：在k-Wave中使用两个仿真步骤，首先仿真一阶声压和速度场。随后，利用这些场通过动量通量密度张量、雷诺应力力和衰减力表达式计算ARF。然后将ARF作为输入用于第二次粘弹性仿真，以估计超声场诱导的组织位移。数值准确性和收敛性被量化为求解器中各种数值选择和超参数的函数。主要结果：在所研究的表达式中，衰减力方法被证明最稳健，并且在可变介质类型和换能器几何形状下最不易受数值误差影响。在TUS相关的参数空间内，它是动量通量密度张量表达式的有效近似。不同ARF表达式得到相似的组织位移分布。然而，位移仿真的准确性随脉冲持续时间增加而下降。最后，就ARF计算方法以及ARF和位移仿真的数值超参数提出了建议。意义：本研究为计算ARF和仿真组织位移提供了指南。所提出的框架能够更全面地表征TUS中超声介导的能量传递。

items.title_en: Accelerating Quantum-Classical Auxiliary-Field Quantum Monte Carlo with Shadow-Trained Neural Quantum States
items.title_zh: 利用影子训练的神经量子态加速量子-经典辅助场量子蒙特卡洛
items.abstract_en: Quantum-classical auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (QC-AFQMC) uses a trial state prepared on a quantum computer to improve the accuracy of the classical AFQMC algorithm. State-of-the-art QC-AFQMC represents this state with matchgate shadows, so every trial-walker overlap and local energy must be averaged over many snapshots, making this classical computation a bottleneck. Here we distill the matchgate shadow data into a symmetry-constrained, noise-aware, autoregressive transformer neural quantum state (NQS). Used as the AFQMC trial state, the NQS evaluates overlaps, force biases, and local energies without repeatedly summing over the matchgate shadows. For a nickel-catalyzed oxidative-addition reaction, the noise-awareness of our NQS design successfully recovers the ideal-upCCD AFQMC barrier and reaction energy within statistical uncertainty, while standard QC-AFQMC execution with the same shadow data yields qualitatively inaccurate results as a result of hardware noise. Since the shadow data are needed only for training, the estimated classical cost for the nickel system falls by approximately 99% relative to our previous QC-AFQMC implementation.
items.abstract_zh: 量子-经典辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（QC-AFQMC）使用在量子计算机上制备的试探态来提高经典AFQMC算法的精度。最先进的QC-AFQMC用matchgate影子表示该态，因此每个试探-行走子重叠和局部能量必须对许多快照求平均，使这一经典计算成为瓶颈。在这里，我们将matchgate影子数据蒸馏为一个受对称性约束、噪声感知的自回归Transformer神经量子态（NQS）。作为AFQMC试探态使用时，NQS评估重叠、力偏差和局部能量，而无需重复对matchgate影子求和。对于镍催化的氧化加成反应，我们NQS设计的噪声感知成功在统计不确定度内恢复了理想upCCD AFQMC的势垒和反应能，而使用相同影子数据的标准QC-AFQMC执行由于硬件噪声而给出定性不准确的结果。由于影子数据仅用于训练，镍体系估计的经典成本相对于我们之前的QC-AFQMC实现下降约99%。

items.title_en: Secrecy and Covertness Analysis of SWAN-Enabled Uplink EDMA-NOMA Systems
items.title_zh: SWAN使能的上行EDMA-NOMA系统保密性与隐蔽性分析
items.abstract_en: Environment division multiple access (EDMA) has recently emerged as a promising multiple-access paradigm by exploiting the wireless propagation environment for user separation, while physical-layer security, including secrecy and covert communication, is becoming increasingly important for protecting confidential information and user privacy. Motivated by these considerations, this paper proposes an EDMA-enabled non-orthogonal multiple access for secrecy and covert communications (EDMA-NOMA-SC) framework for uplink wireless systems. In the proposed framework, a segmented-waveguide-enabled pinching antenna system (SWAN) is employed, where a secrecy user and an intermittently active covert user share the same transmission resource through NOMA within each segment, while a malicious warden attempts to eavesdrop on the secrecy transmission and detect the presence of the covert communication. To capture practical operating conditions, distance-dependent blockage, inter-segment interference, in-waveguide attenuation, imperfect channel state information (ipCSI), and imperfect successive interference cancellation (ipSIC) are considered. Semi-analytical frameworks are developed to characterize the secrecy outage probability (SOP), average secrecy capacity (ASC), false alarm probability (FAP), missed detection probability (MDP), detection error probability (DEP), and covert rate (CR), with their accuracy verified through Monte Carlo simulations. Numerical results, including comparisons with conventional and EDMA-based benchmark schemes, show that the proposed framework generally achieves improved secrecy and covert-rate performance owing to reduced user-to-pinching-antenna propagation distances and in-waveguide attenuation. However, excessive segmentation can degrade performance when inter-segment interference outweighs these propagation benefits.
items.abstract_zh: 环境分割多址接入（EDMA）最近作为一种有前景的多址接入范式出现，它利用无线传播环境进行用户分离；同时，包括保密和隐蔽通信在内的物理层安全对于保护机密信息和用户隐私正变得越来越重要。受这些考虑启发，本文提出一种用于上行无线系统的EDMA使能非正交多址接入保密与隐蔽通信（EDMA-NOMA-SC）框架。在所提框架中，采用分段波导使能的夹持天线系统（SWAN），其中保密用户和间歇活跃的隐蔽用户在每个分段内通过NOMA共享相同传输资源，而恶意监听者试图窃听保密传输并检测隐蔽通信的存在。为捕捉实际工作条件，考虑了距离相关阻塞、段间干扰、波导内衰减、不完美信道状态信息（ipCSI）和不完美连续干扰消除（ipSIC）。开发了半解析框架来表征保密中断概率（SOP）、平均保密容量（ASC）、虚警概率（FAP）、漏检概率（MDP）、检测错误概率（DEP）和隐蔽速率（CR），并通过蒙特卡洛仿真验证了其准确性。数值结果，包括与传统方案和基于EDMA的基准方案的比较，表明由于用户到夹持天线的传播距离缩短以及波导内衰减，所提框架通常实现了更好的保密性和隐蔽速率性能。然而，当段间干扰超过这些传播优势时，过度分段会降低性能。

items.title_en: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
items.title_zh: Scientist World：为AI科学家培育一个研究世界
items.abstract_en: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.
items.abstract_zh: AI科学家已经到来，但供其成长的世界尚未出现。人类科学家将他们的世界视为理所当然——几个世纪的开放问题和共享思想，等待在科学文献中。对于AI科学家而言，那个世界可读但不可运行，因此我们为他们构建了Scientist World：每篇研究论文都成为一个可执行环境。我们的自主流水线提取每篇论文的开放式研究问题，并将其提出的方法复现为基线；进入该环境的AI科学家将对照人类作者所取得的成果进行评估。我们发布了首批1,000个经过验证的环境。以这个世界作为评估，我们发现前沿AI科学家已经能够在74%的情况下超越人类研究者。作为AI如何做科学的记录，它包含6,400小时的研究轨迹，记录了每个想法、实验、失败和成功。作为训练场，我们能够将一个小模型提升（+158%），使其在研究构思上匹配前沿模型。最后，AI科学家自己的世界已经到来，它从科学本身生长而来，并与科学共同成长。

items.title_en: PhySA: Decoupling Aesthetic and Physical Rewards for Humanoid Locomotion
items.title_zh: PhySA：解耦人形机器人运动中的审美奖励与物理奖励
items.abstract_en: Humanoid locomotion policies trained without an explicit smoothness objective tend to produce jerky, high-energy gaits that stress actuators. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer an appealing reward source: given a rendered rollout, a VLM returns an aesthetic quality score on [0,10] without task-specific feature engineering. We find, however, that aesthetic preference and physical smoothness point in opposite directions: across four production VLMs, clips with higher joint acceleration receive higher aesthetic scores (mean Pearson r=+0.66). We study PhySA (Physical Smoothness and Aesthetics), which keeps the two on separate, independently removable reward channels: a sparse, asynchronous VLM score and a phase-triggered correction channel that adjusts physical penalty weights from simulator state. Ablations attribute the smoothness gain to the correction channel. On MuJoCo Humanoid-v5 at 2.6M steps, PhySA lowers joint acceleration by 26 to 32% relative to vanilla PPO, Text2Reward, and Eureka (three seeds), at the cost of shorter episodes. In a single extended run it lowers joint acceleration by 59.5% relative to Prompt2Policy, while a three-seed replication shows a smaller, non-significant reduction (7.2%). The gain does not transfer to IsaacLab or the Unitree G1, even after rescaling the smoothness term.
items.abstract_zh: 在没有明确平滑目标的情况下训练的人形机器人运动策略往往会产生急促、高能量的步态，给执行器带来压力。视觉-语言模型（VLM）提供了一种有吸引力的奖励来源：给定渲染的 rollout，VLM 返回 [0,10] 范围内的审美质量分数，而无需任务特定的特征工程。然而，我们发现审美偏好和物理平滑性指向相反方向：在四个生产级 VLM 中，关节加速度较高的片段获得更高的审美分数（平均 Pearson r=+0.66）。我们研究 PhySA（物理平滑性与审美），它将两者保持在独立、可独立移除的奖励通道上：一个稀疏、异步的 VLM 分数，以及一个根据模拟器状态调整物理惩罚权重的相位触发校正通道。消融将平滑性增益归因于校正通道。在 MuJoCo Humanoid-v5 上，2.6M 步时，PhySA 相对于 vanilla PPO、Text2Reward 和 Eureka（三个种子）将关节加速度降低 26% 至 32%，代价是回合更短。在一次扩展运行中，它相对于 Prompt2Policy 将关节加速度降低 59.5%，而三次种子重复显示较小的、非显著的降低（7.2%）。即使重新缩放平滑项，该增益也无法迁移到 IsaacLab 或 Unitree G1。

items.title_en: Coupled Scene Graph Anticipation: When With-Constraint Recall Hides Structural Inconsistency
items.title_zh: 耦合场景图预测：当带约束召回掩盖结构不一致性
items.abstract_en: Scene Graph Anticipation (SGA) predicts object relationships in future video frames. Continuous-time SGA models evolve each subject-object pair with an independent Neural ODE, so relationships sharing an entity cannot influence one another during integration, and nothing prevents mutually exclusive predictions, such as "sitting on" and "standing on", for the same pair. We introduce CoupledSGA, which links such relationships through a Relationship Interaction Graph with graph attention inside the ODE vector field, and adds a Structural Consistency Loss ($\mathcal{L}_{SC}$) based on a matrix of mutually exclusive predicates. Developing CoupledSGA revealed a limitation of the evaluation protocol. With-Constraint evaluation keeps one predicate per group for each subject-object pair, so its R@K and mR@K cannot capture the within-group violations targeted by $\mathcal{L}_{SC}$: we prove they are unchanged whenever each group's winning predicate and its score are held fixed. We further show that the gradient of $\mathcal{L}_{SC}$ depends on predicate scores rather than ground-truth labels: for two-predicate rules it amplifies the ordering the model already holds, and when all scores in a group are equal it suppresses predicates in more exclusion rules more strongly, explaining why the penalty can lower recall while improving consistency. On Action Genome, activating $\mathcal{L}_{SC}$ after two warm-up epochs reduces R@20 from 42.21% to 35.18% while lowering the No-Constraint contradiction rate from 45.92% to 4.07% (matched-budget R@20: 40.48% CoupledSGA vs. 44.78% SceneSayerODE). CoupledSGA is a testbed, not a state-of-the-art claim: With-Constraint recall captures the cost of enforcing structural consistency but not the improvement. We recommend reporting No-Constraint results alongside a contradiction rate for methods that constrain predicate co-activation.
items.abstract_zh: 场景图预测（SGA）预测未来视频帧中的物体关系。连续时间SGA模型用独立的神经ODE演化每个主体-客体对，因此共享同一实体的关系在积分过程中无法相互影响，也没有任何机制阻止对同一对给出互斥预测，例如“坐在……上”和“站在……上”。我们提出CoupledSGA，它通过关系交互图在ODE向量场内使用图注意力来链接这些关系，并添加基于互斥谓词矩阵的结构一致性损失（$\mathcal{L}_{SC}$）。开发CoupledSGA揭示了评估协议的局限。带约束评估为每个主体-客体对在每个组中保留一个谓词，因此其R@K和mR@K无法捕捉$\mathcal{L}_{SC}$所针对的组内违规：我们证明，只要每组获胜谓词及其分数保持不变，这些指标就不变。我们进一步表明，$\mathcal{L}_{SC}$的梯度取决于谓词分数而非真实标签：对于二谓词规则，它放大模型已持有的排序；当组内所有分数相等时，它对出现在更多排除规则中的谓词抑制更强，这解释了为何该惩罚可在提高一致性的同时降低召回。在Action Genome上，在两个预热轮次后激活$\mathcal{L}_{SC}$将R@20从42.21%降至35.18%，同时将无约束矛盾率从45.92%降至4.07%（匹配预算的R@20：CoupledSGA 40.48% vs. SceneSayerODE 44.78%）。CoupledSGA是一个试验平台，而非最先进水平的声明：带约束召回捕捉了强制结构一致性的代价，但没有捕捉改进。对于约束谓词共激活的方法，我们建议在报告无约束结果的同时报告矛盾率。

items.title_en: Investigating the potential effect of topiramate on anorexia nervosa and binge eating behaviour using drug-target Mendelian randomization
items.title_zh: 使用药物靶点孟德尔随机化研究托吡酯对神经性厌食症和暴食行为的潜在影响
items.abstract_en: Topiramate is an antiseizure medication used to treat epilepsy and migraine and is commonly prescribed for appetite suppression and weight loss. However, whether its pharmacological actions influence eating disorder risk remains unclear. We applied drug-target Mendelian randomization (MR) to investigate potential causal effects of topiramate on the risk of anorexia nervosa (AN; 24,223 cases and 1,243,971 controls) and binge-eating behaviour (BE; 39,279 cases and 1,227,436 controls) and, exploratorily, eight other psychiatric disorders: attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder, anxiety disorders, alcohol use disorder, bipolar disorder, major depressive disorder, panic disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, and schizophrenia. We used summary-data-based Mendelian randomization (SMR) to investigate genetically predicted pharmacological actions of topiramate using brain- and blood-derived cis-expression quantitative trait loci for genes encoding its molecular targets. Five genetic instruments consistent with topiramate's antiepileptic action were validated: CA4 and CACNB3 expression in the brain and CA4, GRIK1, and GRIK3 expression in the blood. Robustness of the findings was assessed using SMR-multi, HEIDI, and colocalization analyses. After multiple-testing correction, genetically predicted inhibition of CA4 expression in blood was associated with decreased BE risk (OR = 0.867, 95% CI = 0.792 - 0.950, p = 0.002) and remained significant in SMR-multi (p = 0.0049). Colocalization provided moderate support for a shared causal variant underlying CA4 expression and BE (PPH4 = 0.58). No robust evidence was identified for AN or the eight exploratory psychiatric outcomes. Overall, our findings warrant further clinical and functional investigations into mechanisms underlying topiramate-associated appetite suppression and weight loss and their relevance to eating-disorder risk.
items.abstract_zh: 托吡酯是一种抗癫痫药物，用于治疗癫痫和偏头痛，常被处方用于抑制食欲和减重。然而，其药理作用是否影响进食障碍风险仍不清楚。我们应用药物靶点孟德尔随机化（MR）研究托吡酯对神经性厌食症（AN；24,223例病例和1,243,971例对照）和暴食行为（BE；39,279例病例和1,227,436例对照）风险的潜在因果效应，并探索性地研究其他八种精神疾病：注意缺陷/多动障碍、焦虑障碍、酒精使用障碍、双相障碍、重性抑郁障碍、惊恐障碍、创伤后应激障碍和精神分裂症。我们使用基于汇总数据的孟德尔随机化（SMR），利用脑源和血源顺式表达数量性状位点（针对编码其分子靶点的基因）来研究托吡酯的遗传预测药理作用。验证了五个与托吡酯抗癫痫作用一致的遗传工具：脑中的CA4和CACNB3表达，以及血液中的CA4、GRIK1和GRIK3表达。使用SMR-multi、HEIDI和共定位分析评估了发现的稳健性。经过多重检验校正后，遗传预测的血液CA4表达抑制与BE风险降低相关（OR = 0.867，95% CI = 0.792 - 0.950，p = 0.002），并且在SMR-multi中仍显著（p = 0.0049）。共定位为CA4表达和BE存在共享因果变异提供了中等支持（PPH4 = 0.58）。未发现针对AN或八个探索性精神疾病结局的稳健证据。总体而言，我们的发现值得进一步开展临床和功能研究，以探究托吡酯相关食欲抑制和减重背后的机制及其与进食障碍风险的相关性。

items.title_en: Goos-Hänchen Shifts at 458 nm from DUV Dichroic Laser Mirrors
items.title_zh: 深紫外二向色激光镜在458 nm处的古斯-汉欣位移
items.abstract_en: We report polarization- and angle-dependent lateral beam shifts observed at 458~nm upon reflection from a deep-ultraviolet (DUV) dichroic multilayer mirror. These Goos--Hänchen (GH) shifts originate from the phase of the complex Fresnel reflection coefficient and are quantitatively reproduced using a transfer-matrix model. Simultaneous reflectance (R), transmittance (T), and GH shift measurements provide complementary constraints on the coating's amplitude and phase response. The analysis is extended to transmission, predicting analogous phase-induced lateral shifts. In frequency-doubling cavities using dichroic mirrors, these phase effects can accumulate over multiple reflections, leading to deviations from ray-optics predictions that may affect cavity mode structure and resonance conditions. Our results show a GH shift of as much as 2~\textmu m (\bm{$\approx 4.4λ$}), which, combined with RT data, enables improved characterization of the phase response of the multilayer coating. The p-polarized reflectance is minimized at a pseudo-Brewster angle of \bm{$θ_B \approx 46^\circ$} at 458~nm, providing a natural reference point around which the GH shift is enhanced.
items.abstract_zh: 我们报告了在458 nm处从深紫外（DUV）二向色多层镜反射时观察到的偏振和角度相关的横向光束位移。这些古斯-汉欣（GH）位移源于复菲涅耳反射系数的相位，并使用传输矩阵模型定量重现。同时测量反射率（R）、透射率（T）和GH位移为镀层的幅度和相位响应提供了互补约束。分析扩展到透射，预测了类似的相位诱导横向位移。在使用二向色镜的倍频腔中，这些相位效应可在多次反射中累积，导致偏离射线光学预测，可能影响腔模结构和共振条件。我们的结果显示GH位移高达2 μm（≈4.4λ），结合RT数据，可改进对多层镀层相位响应的表征。在458 nm处，p偏振反射率在伪布儒斯特角θ_B ≈ 46°处最小，提供了一个自然参考点，GH位移在该点附近增强。

items.title_en: Same Behavior, Different Mechanism: What Finite Experiments Can Certify About Integrated Information
items.title_zh: 相同行为，不同机制：有限实验能就整合信息证明什么
items.abstract_en: Interpretability, AI auditing and assessments of machine consciousness increasingly rest on mechanism-level quantities: functionals of a system's causal transition law that describe how it computes, not what it outputs. Experiments see that law only through finite, partial and noisy interventions. We ask when such a quantity is identifiable from an experiment's access, continuous in the mechanism and certifiable from finite data, and answer exactly for a deliberately demanding case - the integrated information $\varphi$ of integrated information theory - in stochastic networks of four and five units with known ground truth. Behavior can be silent: a recurrent and a feed-forward network with identical input-output laws at their response delay carry 0.28 and 0 bits, yet internal recordings separate them within 4-53 trials. Partial access can be just as blind: in our examples, units left out of a one-step recording impose precision floors of 0.30-1.02 bits that no sample size lowers, and in all-but-self parity networks, recordings of any length see several hidden units only through the product of their fidelities - a symmetry that one intervention broke in exact checks. The measure has sharp edges: because $\varphi$ selects a partition, and the cause and effect it specifies, by one criterion and reports another, infinitesimal changes of mechanism that cross an edge change it by 25-100% at 99% of the edges we found in random networks, and about 1% of surrogate models that fit interventional data almost perfectly misreport it by more than 20%. One-sided claims survive: the same data certify a lower bound on both sides of an edge, and we prove $\varphi>1.004$ bits throughout a 64-dimensional region of mechanisms and certify it from about $10^7$ controlled transitions with false-certificate probability at most $α$. Measurability is thus a design question with computable answers.
items.abstract_zh: 可解释性、AI审计和机器意识评估日益依赖机制层面的量：系统因果转移律的泛函，描述其如何计算，而非输出什么。实验只能通过有限、部分且含噪的干预来观察该定律。我们追问：此类量何时可从实验的访问中识别、在机制上连续、并能从有限数据中得到证明；并针对一个刻意严苛的案例——整合信息理论中的整合信息$\varphi$——在具有已知真值的四单元和五单元随机网络中给出精确回答。行为可能沉默：一个循环网络和一个前馈网络在其响应延迟处具有相同的输入-输出律，分别携带0.28和0比特，但内部记录可在4-53次试验内将它们区分开。部分访问可能同样盲目：在我们的例子中，未被纳入一步记录的单元施加了0.30-1.02比特的精度下限，任何样本量都无法降低；在除自身外的奇偶网络中，任意长度的记录只能通过若干隐藏单元保真度的乘积来看到它们——这种对称性在精确检查中被一次干预打破。该度量具有尖锐边缘：由于$\varphi$按一个准则选择划分及其指定的原因和结果，却报告另一个准则，跨越边缘的机制无穷小变化会使其改变25-100%；在我们于随机网络中找到的99%的边缘处如此，并且约1%几乎完美拟合干预数据的替代模型会将其误报超过20%。单侧断言仍然成立：相同数据可证明边缘两侧的下界，我们证明在一个64维机制区域内$\varphi>1.004$比特，并从约10^7次受控转移中以至多α的误证概率证明它。因此，可测性是一个具有可计算答案的设计问题。

items.title_en: Label-Wording Augmentation in a Typed-Decision Encoder: Gains on Unfamiliar Words, Not on Abbreviations or Codes
items.title_zh: 类型化决策编码器中的标签措辞增强：在不熟悉词语上有增益，而在缩写或代码上没有
items.abstract_en: Typed-decision models score options that the caller supplies at request time, so their accuracy depends on label wording that the model's developer does not control. We compare two releases of a 307M-parameter multilingual cross-encoder, Ru-Jev, trained on thirteen Russian-language tasks; the later release adds an augmentation that presents labels in several surface forms. Holding questions fixed and varying only how eighteen routing labels are worded, we evaluate ten label vocabularies, produced by three separate processes and checked for overlap with the training data, with five candidates per question and, for eight of them, also with eighteen. On held-out vocabularies made of ordinary or borrowed words (English-derived jargon, office slang, department names), the augmented release is more accurate in every setting, by up to 0.24. Eleven of these fourteen gains survive a Holm correction (slang with eighteen candidates and descriptive sentences with five do not), and for jargon on all labels the label-level interval excludes zero in both settings. On abbreviations and opaque codes it gives no usable gain: on abbreviations it is not better, and worse on the clean slice, and on opaque codes both releases stay at or below chance once labels related to training options are removed. In most cells where accuracy rises, the risk-coverage area falls, but with eighteen candidates confident errors rise on jargon and slang. On two datasets neither release saw, accuracy moves by -8.4 and +5.6 points. We also report four evaluation hazards from comparing the two releases.
items.abstract_zh: 类型化决策模型对调用者在请求时提供的选项进行评分，因此其准确性取决于模型开发者无法控制的标签措辞。我们比较了一个307M参数的多语言交叉编码器Ru-Jev的两个版本，该模型在十三个俄语任务上训练；较晚版本增加了一种增强，以多种表面形式呈现标签。在固定问题、仅改变十八个路由标签措辞的情况下，我们评估了十个标签词表，这些词表由三个独立过程生成并检查与训练数据的重叠；每个问题有五个候选，其中八个还使用十八个候选。在由普通词或借词（英语派生行话、办公室俚语、部门名称）构成的留出词表上，增强版本在每种设置中都更准确，最高提升0.24。这十四个增益中有十一个通过Holm校正（十八个候选的俚语和五个候选的描述性句子未通过），对于所有标签上的行话，标签级区间在两种设置中均排除零。在缩写和不透明代码上，它没有给出可用增益：在缩写上并不更好，且在干净切片上更差；在不透明代码上，一旦移除与训练选项相关的标签，两个版本都处于或低于随机水平。在大多数准确率上升的单元格中，风险-覆盖率面积下降，但在十八个候选时，行话和俚语上的自信错误增加。在两个两个版本均未见过的数据集上，准确率分别变化-8.4和+5.6个百分点。我们还报告了比较两个版本时出现的四个评估风险。

items.title_en: Not Losing Your Way: Mitigating Visual-Inertial Odometry Drift through On-Demand Visual Feature Creation
items.title_zh: 不迷失方向：通过按需创建视觉特征缓解视觉-惯性里程计漂移
items.abstract_en: Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) can degrade during aerial inspection in repetitive or poorly textured environments. We propose an active environment-modification framework for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) relying on cameras and an inertial measurement unit only, without prior maps or additional localization sensors. Inspired by the fairy tale of Tom Thumb, the UAV creates visual features on demand by releasing ground markers or marking walls through physical contact. An information-based indicator triggers interventions using temporal confirmation and hysteresis. Evaluation includes three simulated environments and a 900-run factorial campaign. Lower cruise speed and active marking are associated with reduced divergence, while accuracy among non-divergent runs depends on speed-strategy interactions. Corridor experiments, with five runs per configuration, use OptiTrack for flight control while VIO-based marking decisions remain active online. The combined framework reduces the reported position root mean square error by approximately 35% relative to baseline VIO, supporting active feature creation for drift mitigation.
items.abstract_zh: 在重复或纹理较差的环境中进行空中检查时，视觉-惯性里程计（VIO）可能退化。我们提出一种用于无人机（UAV）的主动环境修改框架，仅依赖相机和惯性测量单元，无需先验地图或额外定位传感器。受童话《拇指汤姆》启发，无人机通过释放地面标记或通过物理接触标记墙壁来按需创建视觉特征。基于信息的指标使用时序确认和滞回触发干预。评估包括三个模拟环境和一个900次运行的析因实验。较低的巡航速度和主动标记与发散减少相关，而非发散运行中的准确性取决于速度-策略交互。走廊实验每种配置五次运行，使用OptiTrack进行飞行控制，而基于VIO的标记决策保持在线活跃。与基线VIO相比，该组合框架将报告的位置均方根误差降低约35%，支持通过主动特征创建来缓解漂移。

items.title_en: USB Gym: A Gymnasium Testbed for Closed-Loop Ultrasound View Matching
items.title_zh: USB Gym：用于闭环超声视图匹配的Gymnasium测试平台
items.abstract_en: Background and Objective: Our main goal is ultrasound guidance: moving a probe until its image matches a target view. Published methods for each part of a guide are evaluated in separate simulators. We asked whether these methods, combined into one guide, are good enough. Methods: We built USB Gym, a testbed whose standard engine simulates ultrasound from public patient CT, with a network drawing organ textures from CT labels. Its guide has three replaceable parts (slots), an organ segmenter, a controller and a reward, which received 20 published methods, each run on the same 60 episodes of six held-out patients. In each slot, a published method replaced ours only if detectably better on these patients. The better of this combination and our original guide on 20 new CTs is the benchmark baseline. A pose oracle, reading the exact probe pose available only in simulation, set the reference. The results below are exploratory. Results: On these CTs, the probe started on average 16.0 mm from the target view; the pose oracle brought it to 1.5 mm. Of the results known when the combination was fixed, only an image-similarity reward (SSIM) was slightly but detectably better, so the combination was our guide with that reward. This combination was the benchmark baseline, ending at 13.7 mm (16% of the oracle's progress). Conclusions: Combining untuned published methods with ours did not guide the probe near the target view; the task remains under-explored. The testbed accepts new methods; no guide was tested on hardware.
items.abstract_zh: 背景与目标：我们的主要目标是超声引导：移动探头直到其图像与目标视图匹配。已发表的引导各组成部分的方法分别在独立的模拟器中评估。我们提出疑问：将这些方法组合成一个引导系统后是否足够好。方法：我们构建了USB Gym，一个测试平台，其标准引擎从公开患者CT模拟超声，并用网络从CT标签绘制器官纹理。其引导系统有三个可替换部分（槽位）：器官分割器、控制器和奖励，共接收了20种已发表方法，每种方法在6名留出患者的相同60个回合上运行。在每个槽位中，只有当已发表方法在这些患者上可检测地更好时，才替换我们的方法。在20个新CT上，该组合与我们的原始引导中较好者作为基准基线。姿态 oracle 读取仅在模拟中可获得的精确探头姿态，设定参考。以下结果为探索性结果。结果：在这些CT上，探头平均起始于距目标视图16.0 mm处；姿态 oracle 将其带到1.5 mm。在固定组合时已知的结果中，只有图像相似性奖励（SSIM）略好但可检测地更好，因此该组合是我们的引导加上该奖励。该组合作为基准基线，最终达到13.7 mm（oracle进度的16%）。结论：将未调优的已发表方法与我们的方法组合，并未将探头引导至目标视图附近；该任务仍探索不足。该测试平台接受新方法；没有引导在硬件上测试。

items.title_en: An early activated CD38highCD209highCD36low monocyte phenotype is associated with progression to severe dengue
items.title_zh: 早期激活的CD38highCD209highCD36low单核细胞表型与进展为重症登革热相关
items.abstract_en: Background: Although monocytes are among the principal target cells of dengue virus (DENV) infection we sought to investigate monocyte phenotypic markers associated with disease severity and evaluate their potential as prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets. Methods: Differences in monocyte subpopulations and phenotypic markers were assessed by flow cytometry in patients with dengue fever (DF=33) and dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF=21) and compared to health controls (HCs=20). Further in vitro experiments were done by co-culturing peripheral blood mononucleocytes (PBMCs) of healthy individuals (n=8) with DENV2, DENV3, NS1 antigen of both serotypes and LPS. The changes in expression of CD36 and CD38 in vitro in monocytes were assessed. Results: A significant expansion of intermediate monocytes and a contraction of the classical monocytes was seen in patients with DHF compared to DF and HCs, with no significant differences within the non-classical monocytes. Patients who progressed to develop DHF, exhibited an activated monocyte phenotype characterized by, expansion of CD38high, CD209high, CD86high, HLA-DRhigh, CD36low, intermediate monocyte subset. The highest expression of CD38 and CD86 was seen in non-classical monocytes, and CD209 and HLA-DR in intermediate monocytes. Most significant downregulation of CD36 was observed in non-classical monocytes. CD38 expression on monocytes (especially classical monocytes) positively and significantly correlated with liver transaminases and serum ferritin levels. Co-culture of PBMCs with DENV3 led to significant downregulation of CD36 (p=0.023). Conclusions: These results suggest that early alterations in monocyte activation, antigen presentation, viral entry, and lipid sensing pathways contribute to dengue immunopathogenesis.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：尽管单核细胞是登革病毒（DENV）感染的主要靶细胞之一，我们试图研究与疾病严重程度相关的单核细胞表型标志物，并评估其作为预后生物标志物和治疗靶点的潜力。方法：通过流式细胞术评估登革热（DF=33）和登革出血热（DHF=21）患者单核细胞亚群和表型标志物的差异，并与健康对照（HCs=20）比较。进一步的体外实验通过将健康个体（n=8）的外周血单个核细胞（PBMCs）与DENV2、DENV3、两种血清型的NS1抗原和LPS共培养进行。评估体外单核细胞中CD36和CD38表达的变化。结果：与DF和HCs相比，DHF患者中中间型单核细胞显著扩增，经典单核细胞收缩，非经典单核细胞无显著差异。进展为DHF的患者表现出活化的单核细胞表型，其特征为CD38high、CD209high、CD86high、HLA-DRhigh、CD36low的中间型单核细胞亚群扩增。CD38和CD86的最高表达见于非经典单核细胞，CD209和HLA-DR见于中间型单核细胞。CD36最显著的下调见于非经典单核细胞。单核细胞（尤其是经典单核细胞）上的CD38表达与肝转氨酶和血清铁蛋白水平呈显著正相关。PBMCs与DENV3共培养导致CD36显著下调（p=0.023）。结论：这些结果提示，单核细胞激活、抗原呈递、病毒进入和脂质感知通路的早期改变参与登革热免疫发病机制。

items.title_en: Majorana corner modes and tunable braiding in an altermagnet-superconductor heterostructure
items.title_zh: 交错磁体-超导体异质结构中的马约拉纳角模与可调编织
items.abstract_en: Zeeman fields are usually required for realizing and manipulating Majorana corner modes at the cost of suppressed superconducting pairing. Altermagnetism offers a new route toward realizing Majorana corner modes under zero net external magnetic fields. Here we propose a theoretical scheme to host Majorana corner modes in a honeycomb-lattice altermagnet-superconductor heterostructure. In contrast to previous studies on square lattices, altermagnetism yields distinct effective low-energy edge masses on various inequivalent edges of the honeycomb lattice. Within a low-energy edge-theory framework, we establish the conditions under which Majorana corner modes emerge for both bearded and zigzag edge terminations. We further explicitly construct a complete set of Clifford gates by tuning the altermagnetic anisotropy and chemical potential of the heterostructure. Our results provide a promising platform for the realization and manipulation of Majorana corner modes.
items.abstract_zh: 实现和操纵马约拉纳角模通常需要塞曼场，代价是超导配对被抑制。交错磁性为在零净外部磁场下实现马约拉纳角模提供了新途径。在此，我们提出一种理论方案，在蜂窝晶格交错磁体-超导体异质结构中承载马约拉纳角模。与先前在方晶格上的研究不同，交错磁性在蜂窝晶格的不同非等价边缘上产生不同的有效低能边缘质量。在低能边缘理论框架内，我们建立了在胡须型和锯齿型边缘终止下马约拉纳角模出现的条件。我们进一步通过调节异质结构的交错磁各向异性和化学势，显式构造了一组完整的Clifford门。我们的结果为马约拉纳角模的实现和操纵提供了一个有前景的平台。

items.title_en: A Hidden Markov Preference Model for Online Prediction of Adversary Actions
items.title_zh: 用于在线预测对手动作的隐马尔可夫偏好模型
items.abstract_en: A defender anticipating an attacker needs a probability distribution over the attacker's next action from information available before that action occurs. Two structures complicate this: the attacker's behavioral regime persists and can switch within an episode, and each action combines an operation with state-dependent arguments whose feasible values change over time. We capture both with a hidden Markov model whose latent state is the active regime and whose regime-conditioned action law is defined on a feasibility-masked tree of executable actions. The same likelihood forms the next-action distribution and updates the regime belief once the action is seen, and a partially observed prefix contributes its resolved local factors. Estimation separates into convex logistic fits that Baum-Welch reuses when regimes are unlabeled. We derive a reach-weighted nodewise KL expression for regime information, a sequence-wise log-loss bound for switching regime paths, and a uniform fallback guarantee. On the CAGE 2 cyber defense benchmark the filtered latent state is worth 0.8 nats per step, and after a controller switch the loss begins to fall in three steps against ten for a recurrent baseline.
items.abstract_zh: 防御方在预判攻击方时，需要根据攻击方动作发生之前可获得的信息，给出攻击方下一动作的概率分布。有两种结构使问题复杂化：攻击方的行为模式会持续，并可在一次情节内切换；每个动作将一个操作与状态相关参数组合，而这些参数的可取值随时间变化。我们用隐马尔可夫模型刻画两者，其潜在状态是当前活动模式，其以模式为条件的动作律定义在可执行动作的可行性掩码树上。同一似然既构成下一动作分布，又在该动作被观察到后更新模式信念，而部分观察到的前缀贡献其已解析的局部因子。估计分解为凸逻辑拟合，当模式未标注时Baum-Welch复用这些拟合。我们推导了模式信息的可达加权逐节点KL表达式、切换模式路径的序列级对数损失界，以及均匀回退保证。在CAGE 2网络防御基准上，滤波后的潜在状态每步价值0.8 nats；在控制器切换后，损失开始下降需要三步，而循环基线需要十步。

items.title_en: MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue
items.title_zh: MedGraph：利用图记忆在长期医疗对话中维护患者状态
items.abstract_en: LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient's clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person's health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient's chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.
items.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的医疗助手在多次就诊中跟踪患者，需要一个记忆来在患者临床状态变化时保持其正确。我们考察了五种记忆系统在纵向医疗对话中的错误，发现三个反复出现的原因：检索到的证据给出过时状态、包含他人的健康事实，或缺少答案所依赖的安全性事实。我们提出MedGraph，一种针对这三种情况构建的图记忆。构建过程从每次会话中提取带日期的事实，将每个事实归属到其所描述的人，并将药物、诊断和测量记录链接成保留早期状态的链。检索以患者的链为单位排序，在问题所询问的时间点读取每条链，并加入原始对话文本；患者档案对每个问题列出所有记录的安全性事实。在MedMemoryBench上，MedGraph在GPT和Qwen骨干下均具有最高总体准确率，分别比五个基线中最强者高10.5和10.4分，并在GPT设置下具有高效的记忆构建和回答。

items.title_en: Training-Independent Validation of a Learning-Based Controller for Stunt Maneuvers
items.title_zh: 面向特技机动的学习型控制器的训练无关验证
items.abstract_en: Learned controllers for vehicle maneuvers are usually validated under the conditions and objective used to train them, where they appear highly reliable, yet the parameters that change on real roads are often not those the model was trained on. We argue that validation must be independent of training: it should vary physical parameters that training kept fixed and use acceptance criteria absent from the training objective. A learning-based control policy, G-Maneuver, with 90.11% success is tested for stunt-level maneuvers. A looser terminal-heading score ranked the worst setting as the best. Because real stunt tests are safety-critical, a simulation-to-reality-to-simulation (Sim2Real2Sim) loop uses the simulation to select safe zones for real-vehicle trials with 16.9% acceptance. Automotive safety analysis frameworks are used to identify parameters for validation using coverage tests. We demonstrated that the kinematic stunt-driving indicators, namely heading change, sideslip, and speed-normalized yaw rate, match between simulation and the real world, while force and roll indicators do not, which identifies the indicators that can support safe deployment. A video of the experiments is available at https://youtu.be/dN1Oes8pNIo.
items.abstract_zh: 用于车辆机动的学习型控制器通常在训练所用条件和目标下验证，此时它们看起来高度可靠，但真实道路上发生变化的参数往往不是模型训练时所针对的参数。我们认为验证必须独立于训练：应改变训练中保持固定的物理参数，并使用训练目标中不存在的接受标准。学习型控制策略G-Maneuver以90.11%的成功率针对特技级机动进行测试。一个更宽松的终端航向评分将最差设置评为最佳。由于真实特技测试是安全关键的，采用模拟到现实再到模拟（Sim2Real2Sim）循环，利用模拟为真实车辆试验选择安全区域，接受率为16.9%。使用汽车安全分析框架，通过覆盖测试识别用于验证的参数。我们证明，运动学特技驾驶指标，即航向变化、侧滑和速度归一化偏航率，在模拟与真实世界之间匹配，而力和侧倾指标不匹配，从而识别出可支持安全部署的指标。实验视频见 https://youtu.be/dN1Oes8pNIo。

items.title_en: 4D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Micro-Doppler Differentiable Rendering
items.title_zh: 用于毫米波雷达微多普勒可微渲染的4D点泼溅
items.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave radar resolves the micrometer displacements of a moving body as micro-Doppler, enabling gait, gesture, activity, pose and vital-sign sensing. Each task relies on a downstream model trained on real data, yet radar datasets lag orders of magnitude behind vision and language. Brute-force collection will not close that gap, and existing synthesis methods (forward-only simulators, learned generators and static-scene inverse renderers) cannot fit a real capture of a moving body, leaving a sim2real gap. We present 4D Point Splatting (4DPS), a physics-based differentiable renderer that fits an explicit moving scene to a real capture. Using the synchronized camera to initialize the room and body, we represent the scene as oriented points carrying material, normal and velocity, and splat each point into range and Doppler bins. Our output is the raw complex return a real radar records, so we apply the same signal processing on the rendered data to obtain any representation for training any SOTA downstream model. We fit 235 sequences on HuPR and 100 on RT-Pose, two datasets with different radars. Our reconstructions set the state of the art, with median correlations of 0.940 and 0.830 on range-azimuth, 0.829 and 0.695 on range-Doppler, and 0.988 and 0.966 on micro-Doppler. Our renders also set the state of the art in downstream sim2real gap. On RT-Pose, a pose model trained on them reaches 21.9 cm MPJPE on real data, against 16.7 cm for real training and 127.6 cm for the RF-Genesis baseline, where both the rendered- and real-trained models learn nearly the same features. Our custom CUDA kernels fit a sequence in 5.7 minutes on HuPR and 12.9 on RT-Pose on one H100, making dataset-scale inverse rendering of mmWave radar possible for the first time. This work can enable synthetic data generation for any human-centered downstream task and model, and scene editing for data augmentation.
items.abstract_zh: 毫米波雷达将运动人体的微米级位移解析为微多普勒，从而支持步态、手势、活动、姿态和生命体征感知。每项任务都依赖在真实数据上训练的下游模型，但雷达数据集比视觉和语言数据集落后数个数量级。暴力采集无法弥合这一差距，而现有合成方法（仅前向仿真器、学习式生成器和静态场景逆渲染器）无法拟合运动人体的真实采集，留下sim2real差距。我们提出4D Point Splatting（4DPS），一种基于物理的可微渲染器，可将显式运动场景拟合到真实采集。利用同步相机初始化房间和人体，我们将场景表示为携带材质、法线和速度的有向点，并将每个点泼溅到距离和多普勒bin中。我们的输出是真实雷达记录的原始复数回波，因此我们对渲染数据应用相同的信号处理，以获得任意表示，用于训练任意SOTA下游模型。我们在HuPR上拟合235个序列，在RT-Pose上拟合100个序列，这两个数据集使用不同雷达。我们的重建达到最先进水平，在距离-方位角上的中位相关性为0.940和0.830，在距离-多普勒上为0.829和0.695，在微多普勒上为0.988和0.966。我们的渲染在下游sim2real差距上也达到最先进水平。在RT-Pose上，用这些渲染数据训练的姿态模型在真实数据上达到21.9 cm MPJPE，而真实数据训练为16.7 cm，RF-Genesis基线为127.6 cm，其中渲染训练和真实训练的模型学到几乎相同的特征。我们的自定义CUDA内核在一张H100上拟合一个序列在HuPR上需5.7分钟，在RT-Pose上需12.9分钟，首次使毫米波雷达的数据集规模逆渲染成为可能。这项工作可为任意以人为中心的下游任务和模型实现合成数据生成，并为数据增强实现场景编辑。

items.title_en: Insulin resistance reverses despite weight gain with pan-PPAR agonism, revealing its plasma molecular correlates in type 2 diabetes
items.title_zh: 泛PPAR激动作用下胰岛素抵抗在体重增加时仍发生逆转，揭示2型糖尿病中其血浆分子相关物
items.abstract_en: Insulin resistance (IR) and body weight are closely linked in type 2 diabetes (T2D), so their molecular correlates are hard to separate in observational data. Pan-PPAR agonism offers a test, because it improves insulin sensitivity while body weight increases. In the ChiHOPE cohort of 835 T2D patients from two randomized phase 3 trials of chiglitazar, 53% of chiglitazar-treated patients with HOMA-IR-defined IR at baseline no longer met the IR threshold after treatment, compared with 29% with placebo and 32% with sitagliptin, while BMI rose. We integrated plasma metabolomics and proteomics into a molecular estimate of HOMA-IR. It outperformed routine clinical measures, disagreed with HOMA-IR classification in 27% of patients, and identified adverse lipid, liver and inflammatory profiles within each HOMA-IR class. With chiglitazar, the molecular estimate fell despite weight gain, with lower proteoglycan 4 and higher glutamine and glycine. Circulating markers of IR can therefore improve without weight loss.
items.abstract_zh: 在2型糖尿病（T2D）中，胰岛素抵抗（IR）与体重密切相关，因此其分子相关物在观察性数据中难以分离。泛PPAR激动提供了一种检验，因为它在体重增加的同时改善胰岛素敏感性。在ChiHOPE队列中，该队列包含来自两项chiglitazar随机3期试验的835例T2D患者，基线时经HOMA-IR定义存在IR的chiglitazar治疗患者中，53%在治疗后不再满足IR阈值，而安慰剂组为29%，西格列汀组为32%，同时BMI上升。我们将血浆代谢组学和蛋白质组学整合为HOMA-IR的分子估计。它优于常规临床指标，在27%的患者中与HOMA-IR分类不一致，并在每个HOMA-IR类别内识别出不良脂质、肝脏和炎症谱。使用chiglitazar时，分子估计尽管体重增加仍下降，伴随蛋白聚糖4降低以及谷氨酰胺和甘氨酸升高。因此，IR的循环标志物可以在体重不减轻的情况下改善。

items.title_en: PolyGPT: A Decoder-Only Transformer for Polymer Electrolyte Design
items.title_zh: PolyGPT：用于聚合物电解质设计的仅解码器Transformer
items.abstract_en: Designing polymer electrolytes requires control over both material properties and chemical structure. Here, we present PolyGPT, a Transformer with 38.3 million parameters that generates polymer repeat units from optional property targets, requests to include or exclude a specified chemical feature, and an electrolyte-domain condition. Using the model selected by validation loss, we compared unconditional generation with requests for electrolyte-associated structures, a low glass-transition temperature (Tg), or both. Unconditional and electrolyte-only generation achieved structural validity of 99.46% and 99.59%, respectively. However, electrolyte conditioning increased repetition: uniqueness among valid outputs fell from 99.99% to 51.74%. At a Tg target of 246.11 K, we compared generation with and without electrolyte conditioning, and adding the electrolyte condition slightly reduced the predictor-estimated mean absolute error from 26.97 to 26.07 K, but the fraction of all attempts yielding distinct valid polymers within 50 K of the target fell from 82.35% to 32.31%. When we also required absence from the training catalog, these yields were 59.90% and 19.71%, respectively. The lower yield persisted with a tighter 25 K tolerance. Domain conditioning also weakened control of inclusion requests: the mean fraction of attempts producing valid polymers containing the requested chemical feature fell from 94.27% to 31.27%. Across nine checkpoints, earlier models sometimes produced more distinct, catalog-unseen polymers meeting the Tg target: 10,000 checkpoint model with electrolyte conditioning and 30,000 checkpoint model without it. Together, these results show why property error alone is insufficient for evaluating conditional polymer generation. It must be considered alongside repetition, training-catalog novelty, and whether combined design requests are satisfied.
items.abstract_zh: 设计聚合物电解质需要同时控制材料性质和化学结构。在此，我们提出PolyGPT，一个具有3830万参数的Transformer，可根据可选的性质目标、包含或排除指定化学特征的请求以及电解质领域条件生成聚合物重复单元。使用由验证损失选出的模型，我们比较了无条件生成与请求电解质相关结构、低玻璃化转变温度（Tg）或两者兼有的生成。无条件生成和仅电解质生成的结构有效率分别为99.46%和99.59%。然而，电解质条件化增加了重复：有效输出中的唯一性从99.99%降至51.74%。在Tg目标为246.11 K时，我们比较了有和无电解质条件化的生成，加入电解质条件使预测器估计的平均绝对误差从26.97 K略降至26.07 K，但所有尝试中产生与目标相差50 K以内且互不相同的有效聚合物的比例从82.35%降至32.31%。当我们还要求不存在于训练目录中时，这些产率分别为59.90%和19.71%。在更严格的25 K容差下，较低产率仍然存在。领域条件化也削弱了对包含请求的控制：产生包含所请求化学特征的有效聚合物的尝试平均比例从94.27%降至31.27%。在九个检查点中，较早的模型有时产生更多满足Tg目标的互不相同且训练目录未见过的聚合物：带电解质条件化的10,000检查点模型和不带电解质条件化的30,000检查点模型。总之，这些结果表明为什么仅凭性质误差不足以评估条件聚合物生成。必须同时考虑重复、训练目录新颖性以及组合设计请求是否被满足。

items.title_en: Measured Coupling for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
items.title_zh: 用于扩散语言模型并行解码的实测耦合
items.abstract_en: Diffusion language models can write many tokens per step, but must choose which tokens are safe to commit together. Mean-field decoding penalizes pairs of positions whose predictions look alike. We replace this proxy with the coupling itself: how much committing one token changes the model's confidence at another. Cheap probes inside the main forward pass measure it, with no training or extra model, and it plugs into the same mean-field rule. On three models and four benchmarks, our method needs far fewer steps than mean-field decoding and is faster in most settings, also with a key-value cache, at an average accuracy cost of 1.1 points. Shuffling the couplings or replacing them with a uniform bonus loses this gain.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型可以每步写入许多token，但必须选择哪些token可以安全地一起提交。平均场解码会惩罚预测看起来相似的位置对。我们用耦合本身替代这一代理量：提交一个token会在多大程度上改变模型在另一个位置的置信度。主前向传播内部的廉价探针可测量它，无需训练或额外模型，并可接入相同的平均场规则。在三个模型和四个基准上，我们的方法比平均场解码需要少得多的步骤，并且在大多数设置下更快，在使用键值缓存时也是如此，平均准确率代价为1.1个百分点。打乱耦合或用均匀奖励替代它们会失去这一增益。

items.title_en: UniLoop: Unified Loop Closure Detection from Retrieval to Geometric Verification and Relative Pose Estimation
items.title_zh: UniLoop：从检索到几何验证与相对位姿估计的统一回环检测
items.abstract_en: Loop closure detection conventionally cascades separate models for global retrieval, geometric verification, and relative pose estimation, leading to redundant computation and disconnected visual representations. We propose UniLoop, a unified framework that reuses the hierarchical representations of the pretrained geometric foundation model throughout this pipeline. A shared image encoder produces features for compact global descriptors; the same features are passed to the cross-view decoder for pairwise verification; and the original geometric predictions provide relative camera constraints for pose-graph optimization. Experiments on place recognition, loop verification, and relative pose estimation show that UniLoop improves loop-closure robustness and accuracy while reducing redundant backbone computation relative to modular pipelines. UniLoop achieves the best Recall@10 on MSLS (96.6) and Pitts30k (99.3) among the compared methods, while its verification branch reaches 95.63 AP and 96.29 ROC-AUC, surpassing the existing geometric verification baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 回环检测通常级联用于全局检索、几何验证和相对位姿估计的独立模型，导致冗余计算和割裂的视觉表示。我们提出UniLoop，一个统一框架，在整个流程中复用预训练几何基础模型的分层表示。共享图像编码器生成紧凑全局描述子的特征；相同特征被送入跨视角解码器进行成对验证；原始几何预测为位姿图优化提供相对相机约束。在地点识别、回环验证和相对位姿估计上的实验表明，相对于模块化流程，UniLoop提高了回环检测的鲁棒性和准确性，同时减少了冗余骨干计算。在比较方法中，UniLoop在MSLS（96.6）和Pitts30k（99.3）上取得最佳Recall@10，其验证分支达到95.63 AP和96.29 ROC-AUC，超过现有几何验证基线。
